jobs.title: Fullstack .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Een positieve toekomst voor iedereen daar werken we bij Sopra Steria aan. Met meer dan 56.000 collega's in 30 landen zijn we Europa's toonaangevende leverancier van digitale oplossingen. Wij weten als geen ander dat het niet alleen technologie is die transformatie aanstuurt. Het zijn mensen die de kern van verandering vormen. Daarom zijn het mensen die centraal staan in alles wat we doen en bieden we een ondersteunende en inclusieve omgeving waar iedereen zowel individueel als in teamverband kan uitblinken.

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.

Vacatureomschrijving

Heb jij een passie voor Microsoft-technologie en wil je jouw backend-expertise combineren met de dynamiek van moderne frontend-frameworks? Binnen de Microsoft Area van Sopra Steria werk je samen met ervaren engineers aan complexe, impactvolle projecten voor klanten binnen defensie, de publieke sector, financiële dienstverlening en de industrie. Hier combineer je end-to-end vakmanschap met échte maatschappelijke impact en maak je dagelijks het verschil!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Fullstack Developer werk je in multidisciplinaire DevOps-teams aan complexe IT-vraagstukken. Je bent de brug tussen een ijzersterke .NET backend en een intuïtieve, moderne frontend. Je ontwikkelt toekomstbestendige oplossingen en levert code waar je trots op bent: schoon, onderhoudbaar, goed getest en klaar voor de toekomst.

Kwaliteit staat voorop. Geen snelle fixes, maar doordachte oplossingen. Je denkt actief mee over software-architectuur, designkeuzes en technische standaarden, waarbij je zowel de logica in de backend als de performance in de frontend bewaakt.

Een voorbeeld van een opdracht kan het volgende inhouden:

Migraties & Modernisering: Een verouderde Microsoft .NET applicatie (met bijvoorbeeld .NET Framework 4.8) migreren naar .NET 8, en tegelijkertijd de user interface herbouwen in een modern JavaScript-framework zoals Angular, React of Vue.
Cloud & Architectuur: Een nieuwe Azure-omgeving inrichten met Infrastructure as Code (IaC), waarbij je microservices in .NET naadloos laat communiceren met een schaalbare frontend.
Security & Optimalisatie: MFA implementeren in een bestaande applicatie en de API-performance optimaliseren om de laadtijden in de browser drastisch te verkorten.

Functie-eisen

Wat neem jij mee?

Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring als .NET Developer, met sterke kennis van .NET (C#) en moderne .NET Core/.NET 8 architecturen en bij voorkeur ervaring met Azure DevOps en/of Github. Werk jij er nog niet mee? Dan sta jij ervoor open om dit snel eigen te maken.
Naast een sterke backend (.NET)-basis, beschik jij ook over aantoonbare kennis van en ervaring met ten minste één modern JavaScript-framework (zoals Angular, React of Vue).
Ervaring met werken in een Agile/Scrum-omgeving en gewend om samen te werken binnen een DevOps-team.
Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Informatica (of vergelijkbaar), communiceert goed in het Nederlands en werkt graag samen in een team waar kennisdeling centraal staat.
Jij hebt een positieve, oplossingsgerichte mindset en vindt het belangrijk om kwalitatief goede, onderhoudbare code te schrijven.
Jij blijft jezelf ontwikkelen, volgt technologische ontwikkelingen actief, bent gemotiveerd om certificeringen te behalen en het lijkt jou gaaf om onderdeel te worden van onze Microsoft Community waarin kennisdeling centraal staat.

Aanvullende informatie

Dit krijg je van ons!

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

Een vast contract en een salaris tussen de €4.000,- en €6.000,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week, dienstverband minimaal 32 uur).
Bij Sopra Steria vinden we gelijke beloning voor gelijkwaardig werk belangrijk. Daarom bepalen we je salaris op basis van objectieve criteria zoals ervaring, kennis, competenties en verantwoordelijkheden. Zo zorgen we voor een eerlijke en transparante beloning die past bij jouw achtergrond en de impact van je rol.
Vakantiegeld van 8%;
Een winstdelingsregeling met een target-uitkering van 8% van het bruto (parttime) jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaten;
Een mobiliteitsregeling met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto of een alternatieve vervoersregeling, passend bij jouw situatie;
27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen aan- of te verkopen;
Flexibele hybride werkomstandigheden: thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant, afhankelijk van de functie en de mogelijkheden binnen opdrachten;
Een thuiswerkpakket met laptop, telefoon en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding;
Volop mogelijkheden voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling via trainingen, certificeringen, kennissessies en inspirerende events;
Diverse sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van informele borrels tot sportieve en inhoudelijke evenementen;
Mogelijkheden voor fiscaal vriendelijke aflossing van jouw studieschuld;
Een uitgebreid aanbod aan voordelen via ons cafetariamodel, waaronder een fietsregeling, sportabonnementen, zonnepanelen en collectieve verzekeringen;
Een pensioenregeling met een werkgeversbijdrage en de mogelijkheid om vrijwillig aanvullende pensioenopbouw te realiseren.
Bij Sopra Steria geloven we in continue groei. Je krijgt de ruimte om je verder te specialiseren binnen Microsoft-technologie en certificeringen te behalen én te onderhouden, zoals AI-200 en AZ-400.

Wat ons écht onderscheidt?

Bij ons draait het niet alleen om projecten, maar ook om jouw groei als Microsoft professional. Je krijgt een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan, begeleiding van ervaren specialisten en alle ruimte om door te groeien naar een volgende stap, technisch én professioneel.

Met meer dan 180 Microsoft-specialisten werk je in één van de grootste Microsoft-communities van Nederland. Van .NET en software-architectuur tot Power Platform, Data & AI en Security kennis is hier overal. We hebben meerdere MVP’s en MCT’s in huis en zijn trots Microsoft Solution Partner.

Kennisdeling en plezier. Maandelijkse track-meetings, inspiratiesessies en een actief Inspirator- en accelerator programma helpen je om jezelf én anderen beter te maken. En natuurlijk bezoeken we samen toonaangevende conferenties zoals Future Tech en maken we ook tijd voor teamuitjes die je niet snel vergeet.

Klaar om te groeien?
 Klaar voor een nieuwe uitdaging bij een bedrijf dat net zo in beweging is als jij? Neem contact op met Mathilda van Delden: mathilda.vandelden@soprasteria.com of solliciteer direct. We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten!

______

Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

jobs.title: .Net developer
jobs.description:
Job Description

NET Developer

Bij Sogeti werk je als .NET Developer in een omgeving waar technologie, vakmanschap en community centraal staan. Je maakt deel uit van multidisciplinaire DevOps‑ en platformteams en werkt aan schaalbare, toekomstbestendige oplossingen voor organisaties waar technologie direct bijdraagt aan groei, innovatie en continuïteit. Denk aan moderne business‑applicaties, cloud‑native services, integraties en AI‑ondersteunde ontwikkeloplossingen.

Als strategische Microsoft‑partner met een sterke engineering‑focus investeren we actief in onze Microsoft Community. Je wordt onderdeel van een community waarin kennisdeling, experimenteren en persoonlijke expertiseontwikkeling vanzelfsprekend zijn. Vanuit ons kantoor in Utrecht – en daarbuiten – organiseren we maandelijkse Microsoft meet‑ups, deep dives en hands‑on sessies over onder andere .NET, Azure, GitHub, Developer Experience en AI‑gedreven development.

Werken als .NET Developer bij Sogeti

Als .NET Developer werk je aan projecten met een duidelijke technische uitdaging en zichtbare impact. Je ontwikkelt oplossingen in .NET (Core/Framework), C#, Azure en moderne ontwikkelplatformen, waarbij je pragmatische keuzes maakt die passen bij de schaal en ambities van de organisatie.

Je werkt voor klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren, vaak organisaties met een duidelijke groei‑ of moderniseringsambitie, waar je als developer directe invloed hebt op zowel de oplossing als de manier van werken. Je denkt actief mee over architectuur, performance, security en maintainability en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor keuzes die het ontwikkelproces, het platform en de developer experience verbeteren.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een sterk analytisch vermogen en denkt graag mee over technische keuzes en architectuur. Je communiceert duidelijk, werkt goed samen in teams en neemt initiatief om de klant te helpen het beste resultaat te behalen.
Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 4 jaar ervaring met softwareontwikkeling.
Je hebt ervaring met .NET Framework/Core, C#, Azure (Functions, App Services), REST APIs, MVC en/of JavaScript/TypeScript.
Je hebt affiniteit met AI, DevOps, CI/CD en containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal op minimaal B2-niveau.

Dit bieden wij jou

Een dienstverband van 40 uur per week, met flexibele mogelijkheden om parttime te werken.
Een startsalaris tussen de €55.000 en €70.000 bruto per jaar (inclusief vakantiegeld en mobiliteitsbudget).
Een flexibel mobiliteitsbudget, met o.a. opties om elektrisch te rijden.
Hybride werken en een goede werk-privébalans.
Uitgebreide opleidings- en certificeringsmogelijkheden.
26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de optie om extra dagen bij te kopen.
Uitdagende projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties waarin jouw technische expertise het verschil maakt.
Toegang tot onze kenniscommunity, meet-ups, hackathons en tech-events. En natuurlijk: ontspanning via game nights, skitrips en meer.

Ben jij nieuwsgierig geworden naar de projecten waar wij dagelijks aan werken en wil jij deel uitmaken van onze actieve Microsoft Community?

Solliciteer nu en ontdek hoe jij het verschil kunt maken!

Een PES-screening en assessment maken deel uit van het proces.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
Azure Integration Developer
jobs.description:
Jouw veld van expertise

Als Azure Integration Developer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en optimaliseren van integraties tussen systemen met behulp van Azure Integration Services. Je werkt als onderdeel van een Agile DevOps team aan het ontwerp, de realisatie, het testen en de oplevering van de oplossing. Je wordt enthousiast van het inzetten van low/no code voor het oplossen van complexe integratie vraagstukken. Je hebt een focus op Azure Integration Services, maar als je breder georiënteerd bent dan is er alle ruimte om je technische skills in te zetten.

Wat jij kan doen als expert

Afhankelijk van je senioriteit, kennis en ambitie kan je de lead nemen in initiatieven bij de klant. Op de meeste projecten werk je met een team van senior consultants, maar je kan ook een keer alleen op een project zitten. Je werkt doorgaans samen met Solution architecten, key users, project managers, leveranciers, Scrum Masters, Product Owners en testers.

Waar je op kunt bouwen

Plan zelf je reis naar werkgeluk en vorm jouw eigen ultieme carrière in overleg met je Employee Success Manager.
Aandacht voor work-life balance, bijvoorbeeld de mogelijkheid om 32 uur per week te werken.
Wij geloven niet in hokjesdenken. Daarom hebben wij géén functiehuizen, salarisschalen of vaste profielen.
Direct een contract voor onbepaalde tijd!
Enkel senior en gespecialiseerde collega’s met een gedeelde passie voor integratievraagstukken en cloud.
De mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan het integratie cluster.
Innovatieve cloud opdrachten in complexe klantomgevingen.
Een team dat regelmatig bij elkaar komt om samen te eten en kennis te delen.

Welke bouwstenen neem je mee

Een afgeronde HBO-opleiding.
Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als C#/.NET developer.
Stevige ervaring met Azure Integration Services.
Aantoonbare ervaring met Azure API Management.
Kennis van Infrastructure as Code: yml pipelines, ARM templates en Azure Bicep.
Ondanks je developer-hart, word je niet verdrietig van het gebruik van low code/no code.
DevOps is jouw manier van werken!
Je begrijpt dat certificeringen belangrijk zijn en daarom heb je 'Azure Developer Associate'/ ‘Developing Solutions for Microsoft Azure’ gehaald of ben je daarmee bezig.
Communiceren, adviseren, innoveren. You know the drill.
Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer Azure en Kubernetes
jobs.description:
In het kort

De afdeling Software Services zorgt ervoor dat al onze klanten zelf of via hun adviseur online hun hypotheek kunnen regelen. Wij maken dit mogelijk door het realiseren van maatwerkapplicaties waarmee we onze adviseurs, klanten en medewerkers optimaal kunnen bedienen. Dit doen we met meerdere teams die het DevOps ideaal in de praktijk brengen. Het platformteam is daarin een cruciale factor.

Je werk

We zoeken een software engineer met ervaring met en/of ambities naar platform engineer. In ons platform team tillen we development teams naar een hoger niveau door Infrastructuur as Code, templates, self-service oplossingen en andere resources aan te leveren zodat de teams snel waarde kunnen leveren met hun applicaties op Kubernetes. Ook ontwikkelen we zelf een aantal business gedreven Frontend en Backend applicaties zodat we zelf onze eerste klant zijn. Dit betekent dat we altijd op zoek zijn naar verbeteringen in onze code, stack en kennis. Voor elk teamlid is het blijven leren en verbeteren is daarbij belangrijk. Daar krijg je dan ook elke kans voor. Het is belangrijker dat je oog hebt voor kwaliteit en graag leert dan dat je specifieke tools en technieken al beheerst.

We zijn een gezellig team van specialisten; samen brainstormen en het oplossen van problemen staan bij ons hoog in het vaandel. Daarnaast zijn we een vraagbaak voor collega's uit andere teams en helpen we hen vaak met onze kennis en ideeën. De kennis die je nog niet hebt doe je graag op en nieuwe uitdagingen pak je met beide handen aan. Als deze mindset bij je past, is Team B een grote kans om je kennis en kunde uit te breiden en aan te scherpen.

Werkomgeving

Ons kantoor is gevestigd in Amersfoort, vlak bij het station, en de sfeer op onze afdeling is gezellig en ontspannen. Passie voor je vak, ondernemerschap en vakmanschap vinden wij belangrijk op de afdeling. De cultuur is informeel, wij zijn open naar elkaar, vieren successen en organiseren regelmatig afdelingsuitjes. We zien onze collega's graag 1 of 2 dagen per week op kantoor. De overige dagen werken we vanuit huis. We zoeken iemand met academisch/ HBO opleidings- en werkniveau die beschikbaar is voor 32, 36 of 40 uur. Onze voertaal is Nederlands omdat onze business ook volledig Nederlands opereert.

Je profiel

Je hebt kennis van Kubernetes (liefst AKS); bonuspunten voor ervaring met kubernetes-tooling zoals Istio, Calico, Helm en Prometheus;
Je kunt je door programmeerervaring binnen het Microsoft-domein goed verplaatsen in de behoeften van andere .NET-ontwikkelaars;
Je hebt affiniteit met Platform Engineering;
Je verkent graag nieuwe clouddiensten binnen Azure en weet die op een veilige manier te ontsluiten voor andere ontwikkelaars (en je eigen team);
Je voelt je thuis in de wereld van CI/CD, IaC, pipelines, git en shift-left;
Security, schaalbaarheid en robuustheid van onze oplossingen verlies je niet uit het oog;
Je excelleert in .NET en bouwt daarmee graag nieuwe microservices;
Je bent trots op je werk en presenteert je ideeën en resultaten graag aan andere ontwikkelaars.
Je beschikt over een minimum van B2 Nederlands in woord en geschrift

Wij bieden

Het is voor ons belangrijk om een goede werkgever te zijn. Wij bieden je daarom een functie met impact en uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden die bijdragen aan jouw werkplezier, ontwikkeling en wellbeing.

Daarnaast bieden wij:

Een aantrekkelijk bruto maandsalaris op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Dit is inclusief vakantiegeld en een flexibel benefit budget.
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling, zodat je goed voorbereid bent voor later.
Flexibiliteit in werken: thuiswerken is mogelijk in overleg met je team en afhankelijk van je functie. Wij regelen een ergonomische thuiswerkplek voor je.

jobs.title: Research Assistant at the Donders Centre for Cognition: Computational Modelling and Scientific Software
jobs.description:
Are you interested in advanced computational modelling and state-of-the-art scientific software? Join us in creating the Bayesian multiverse: a computational framework for robust statistical analyses, applicable across empirical research domains. The position offers the opportunity to work on the combination of state-of-the-art scientific computing and Bayesian statistics, and to contribute to an open-source scientific software library.

You will be part of a larger project at the Uncertainty in Complex Systems lab (PI: Dr Max Hinne) aimed at learning which statistical and/or computational model is most suited for a provided data set and scientific question. In practice, statistical models contain many arbitrary choices that may (a) have a detrimental effect on what we can learn from it and (b) greatly reduces the reproducibility of scientific research, as different researchers make different decisions. A Bayesian multiverse is a systematic way of reducing these adverse effects and aims to make statistical analyses more robust.

We are looking for a research assistant to contribute to the development of bamojax (Bayesian modelling in JAX), our open-source Python toolbox for Bayesian modelling and model comparison. Throughout your employment, you will have the opportunity to work with others within our group to see what modelling choices they make, and how our new Bayesian multiverse tools can help with this. There will be weekly meetings with the PI to discuss the project's progress and next steps, as well as bi-weekly lab meetings.

You will have two core tasks. The first is to implement advanced methods for Bayesian model comparison in JAX. These techniques will then be used to systematically explore alternative models for user-defined statistical problems. The second task is to construct an efficient search procedure for variants of a given model.

Profile

You have an MSc degree in computer science, data science, AI, applied mathematics, or a related discipline.
You have demonstrable experience with programming in Python and implementing statistical or machine learning algorithms.
You have experience with software development practices such as testing and version control with Git.
You have a solid mathematical background in, for example, probability, statistics, calculus and linear algebra.
You have good communication skills.
You have a passion for improving the scientific process.
Prior experience with Bayesian statistics and/or JAX is a plus.

We offer

We will give you a temporary employment contract of 1 year.
Your salary within salary scale 7 depends on your previous education and number of years of (relevant) work experience. The amounts in the scale are based on a 38-hour working week.
You will receive an 8% holiday allowance and an 8,3% end-of-year bonus.
You will receive extra days off. With full-time employment, you can choose between 30 or 41 days of annual leave instead of the statutory 20.

Additional Employment Conditions

Work and science require good employment practices. This is reflected in Radboud University's primary and secondary employment conditions. You can make arrangements for the best possible work-life balance with flexible working hours, various leave arrangements and working from home. You are also able to compose part of your employment conditions yourself, for example, exchange income for extra leave days and receive a reimbursement for your sports subscription. And of course, we offer a good pension plan. You are given plenty of room and responsibility to develop your talents and realise your ambitions. Therefore, we provide various training and development schemes.

We are

The Donders Institute for Brain, Cognition and Behaviour is a world-class interfaculty research centre that houses more than 700 researchers devoted to understanding the mechanistic underpinnings of the human mind. Research at the Donders Institute is focused around four themes:

Language and communication.
Perception, action and decision-making.
Development and lifelong plasticity.
Natural computing and neurotechnology.

Excellent, state-of-the-art research facilities are available for the broad range of neuroscience research that is being conducted at the Donders Institute. The Donders Institute has been assessed by an international evaluation committee as ‘excellent’ and recognised as a ‘very stimulating environment for top researchers, as well as for young talent’. The Donders Institute fosters a collaborative, multidisciplinary and supportive research environment with a diverse international staff. English is the lingua franca at the Institute.

Practical information and applying

You can apply only via the button below. Address your letter of application to Max Hinne. In the application form, you will find which documents you need to include with your application. We look forward to receiving your application.

The first interviews will take place on Monday 2 November. Any second interview will take place on Thursday 19 November. Prior to the second-round interview, candidates will receive an assignment, which they will be asked to present during the interview.

You will preferably start your employment on 1 January 2027.

We can imagine you're curious about our application procedure. It describes what you can expect during the application procedure and how we handle your personal data and internal and external candidates. If you wish to apply for a non-scientific position with a non-EU nationality, please take notice of the following information.

Do you already work at Radboud University and have questions about making an internal move? Learn more about internal applications.

jobs.description:
Staff Backend Engineer – Platform

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there.

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be up to

Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems.
Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently.
Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment.
Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders.
Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence.
Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably.
Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available.
Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents.
Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement.

Some of the challenges waiting for you

Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally).
Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery.
Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch.
Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level.

What you'll bring to the team

8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role.
Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used.
A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team.
Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well).
Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack).
Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function.
Fluent English.

Nice to have

Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong.
Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation).
Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent).
Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams.

What we offer

Culture and growth

A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities.
Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework.
Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency.
Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up.
Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams.

Perks and lifestyle

Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team.
A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany.
Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events.
30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired.
An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options.

Where you'll work from

This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We're also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

Job Description

About us

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from healthcare to social care. We work closely with our Finnish customers to develop our own products and services. We want to provide solutions which enable healthcare and social care professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients and customers. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

About The Role

We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join a Patient Engagement development team. Our activities are directed at supporting the citizen-oriented parts of the healthcare system manufactured by Tieto and they include analysis, design, development, testing, maintenance, and release tasks. You will have opportunities to design and develop new features, maintain existing applications, and configure them in our SaaS environments. The work is going to be performed in a hybrid mode, giving the opportunity to work either from the office or from home, according to the agreed schedule.

Who we are looking for:

You live in (or at a commuting distance to) Szczecin, Warsaw or Wroclaw.
You have a good working proficiency in English, both spoken and written.
You have at least 3 years of experience of working professionally as a Software Engineer on commercial projects.
You have a full stack developer attitude with the primary focus on backend development
You have good practical knowledge of .Net framework, .Net 8+, and SQL, especially the Microsoft SQL flavor, including the Service broker functionality. You can use the Entity Framework in C# to access and use the databases.
You are a person with confidence to take responsibility and ownership.
You have the right personality and attitude to work together in a team, learn from your peers and pass on what you’ve learned to others.
You consider the testing as a natural component of the development flow, both in terms of creating unit/integration tests as well as executing the manual tests in the test environments.
You are familiar with web services (REST, SOAP) and know how to develop, deploy, and test them using IIS as a host

Nice to have skills:

You have experience in developing software for the SaaS environments.
You have basic experience with Angular, CSS, HTML, Javascript.
You are familiar with Git and Azure DevOps

We offer

We offer you an inspiring position with great opportunities for professional growth. With us you will have the opportunity to directly influence your career development. If you have good ideas, people will listen to you. What's more, we offer you a job that suits you. At Tieto, we promote a healthy work-life balance and a friendly, caring atmosphere. We believe that trust fosters freedom and creativity. Our culture is built on transparency and active sharing – a truly open environment.

In addition to this we offer you great benefits and opportunity to work with inspiring colleagues. With us you will be working with highly skilled professionals and experience being a part of the Tieto software development network.

Did we get you inspired?

We look forward to your application! Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact Tomasz Lisowski ( tomasz.lisowski@tieto.com)

What’s in it for you?

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy Architekta IT / Software Architecta
, który będzie odpowiedzialny za projektowanie i rozwój architektury systemów oraz wsparcie zespołów deweloperskich w procesie transformacji technologicznej.

Szukamy osoby, która dobrze odnajduje się na styku technologii i biznesu, potrafi podejmować samodzielne decyzje architektoniczne, ale jednocześnie potrafi przełożyć je na konkretne rozwiązania i jasno wyjaśnić ich uzasadnienie.

Twój zakres obowiązków

Projektowanie architektury nowych oraz istniejących systemów, zarówno monolitycznych, jak i opartych o mikroserwisy.
Prowadzenie i wspieranie procesów modernizacyjnych, w tym refaktoryzacji i migracji systemów.
Przeprowadzanie analiz technicznych oraz tworzenie dokumentacji architektonicznej.
Udział w projektach transformacji technologicznej w roli eksperta technologicznego i partnera dla biznesu.
Rekomendowanie oraz dobór technologii z uwzględnieniem bezpieczeństwa, wydajności i skalowalności.
Projektowanie i rozwój rozwiązań opartych o API.
Wsparcie zespołów developerskich w podejmowaniu decyzji technicznych.
Dzielenie się wiedzą i mentoring techniczny.
Identyfikowanie obszarów wymagających usprawnień oraz proponowanie kierunków rozwoju architektury.
Współpraca z zespołami IT, biznesem oraz innymi interesariuszami.

Bardzo dobra znajomość .NET Framework oraz .NET Core / .NET 6+.
Doświadczenie w pracy z PHP 5.x-8.x oraz starszymi frameworkami, np. Zend, Symfony 2/3.
Praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy z monolitami oraz ich modernizacji.
Dobra znajomość SQL oraz relacyjnych baz danych, w szczególności MS SQL, MySQL lub PostgreSQL.
Doświadczenie w projektowaniu i budowie API - REST, SOAP; znajomość GraphQL będzie dodatkowym atutem.
Znajomość wzorców architektonicznych, w szczególności DDD (Domain-Driven Design).
Umiejętność analizy technicznej i podejmowania decyzji architektonicznych.
Umiejętność przekładania decyzji technicznych i ich konsekwencji na język biznesu.
Proaktywne podejście i gotowość do proponowania usprawnień oraz nowych kierunków rozwoju.
Bardzo dobre umiejętności komunikacyjne i umiejętność współpracy zarówno z zespołami IT, jak i biznesem.
Samodzielność w podejmowaniu decyzji technicznych.

To oferujemy

Stabilność zatrudnienia - długofalowe projekty, współpraca z wiodącymi firmami, możliwość rozwoju w różnych obszarach branży IT.
Elastyczne formy współpracy - umowa B2B, umowa o pracę lub zlecenie.
Benefity: Medicover (rozszerzony o stomatologię), FitProfit, lekcje języka angielskiego.
Treningi na siłowni F45 - zlokalizowanej w naszym biurze. Wspólnie ćwiczymy pod okiem profesjonalnych trenerów.
Wewnętrzny program poleceń.
Możliwość finansowania certyfikatów IT.
W zależności od projektu pracujemy w trybie hybrydowym, zdalnym lub stacjonarnym.
Wydarzenia okolicznościowe oraz wyjazdy integracyjne - budujemy zgrany zespól również poza biurem.

jobs.description:
At ABB
, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Manager

__

Help shape the next generation of digital services at ABB Electrification Service Division. We are look-ing for a Senior AI Engineer – Agentic Systems to unlock agentic AI capabilities across our digital port-folio and turn them into real customer value. In this role, you will help build intelligent systems that support customers in achieving their most important asset management goals: higher reliability, bet-ter predictability, greater availability, improved sustainability, and smarter lifecycle decisions. You will work at the intersection of AI, backend engineering, and enterprise integration to transform architec-tural designs into secure, scalable, production-ready solutions.

ABB’s digital and service portfolio is increasingly focused on customer experience, comprehensive as-set management, digital enablement, and sustainability outcomes. This role is a key enabler for trans-lating that portfolio direction into intelligent products and workflows that help customers reduce downtime, improve maintenance decisions, optimize operations, and extend asset life.

As a Senior AI Engineer – Agentic Systems, you will build, integrate, and operate production-grade AI agents and agentic workflows across ABB ELSE digital services. You will own the engineering required to move beyond pilots into secure, reliable, enterprise-ready solutions. This includes agent orchestra-tion, enterprise tool integration, evaluation, monitoring, control mechanisms, and operational excel-lence. The role also has an important team uplift dimension: you will mentor colleagues and help raise the internal bar in agentic AI engineering.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

Develop AI agents and multi-step workflows that support ELSE digital service and asset management use cases.
Turn solution designs into scalable, production-ready implementations across the ELSE landscape.
Connect agent workflows with enterprise platforms, operational data, APIs, and digital tools used in ELSE services.
Define effective patterns for tool use, context management, memory, orchestration, and workflow execution.
Create evaluation and validation approaches to ensure agent quality, safety, accuracy, and performance in real use cases.
Implement human approval flows, fallback mechanisms, and operational guardrails.
Ensure production readiness through testing, monitoring, deployment automation, and controlled releases.
Work closely with architects, product owners, data engineers, and software teams to deliver reliable, business-ready ELSE solutions.

Qualifications for the role :

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
7+ years of experience in software engineering, including designing and delivering enterprise-grade backend and cloud-based solutions.
2-3+ years of hands-on experience building AI-powered applications, LLM-integrated systems, or agent-based workflows in production environments.
Strong backend engineering skills, ideally in C#/.NET, with Python as a strong plus.
Strong experience with APIs, Git, CI/CD, cloud deployment, and secure enterprise integration.
Experience with agent evaluation, testing, verification, RAG, memory patterns, context man-agement, and agent control mechanisms.
Experience monitoring and optimizing AI systems for reliability, performance, and cost.
Understanding Microsoft enterprise security, compliance, and identity patterns, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams and mentor colleagues.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com
to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Project Description:

Luxoft is an industry-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC-Luxoft.

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
AI Labs is a sub-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self-serve access to the AI-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.

Your Skills And Experiences

- BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
- Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
- Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C#, PowerShell, Python
- Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
- Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
- Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
- Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
- Proactive thinking, excellent problem-solving, and analytical skills

- Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
- Fluent in English

Preferred Skills

- Strong coding skills (e.g. C#, PowerShell)
- Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
- Strong experience in cloud security and compliance

- Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.

Responsibilities:

- Act as a trusted advisor for the customer to ensure alignment with strategic goals, advocate customer's interests when working in a diverse team of various stakeholders, and promote cutting-edge cloud technologies.

The Sr. Technical Architect is responsible for supporting Fortrea's technology vision, solution architecture strategy, and engineering architecture standards across the company's digital products, platforms, and technology portfolio.

This role provides senior technical leadership by supporting cloud-native architecture patterns, AI-enabled architecture, engineering standards, integration strategies, platform engineering capabilities, reusable technology frameworks, and architecture governance that enable secure, scalable, resilient, high-performing, and AI-ready software solutions.

As one of Fortrea's senior technical leaders, the Sr. Technical Architect partners closely with Product Management, Product Engineering, Platform Engineering, Data & AI, Security, Infrastructure, and Enterprise Architecture to ensure technology investments align with business priorities while accelerating innovation and long-term platform evolution.

The Sr. Technical Architect serves as a trusted technical advisor by driving modernization initiatives, enabling AI-powered software development, providing technical guidance to project teams and less-experienced colleagues, supporting engineering standards, and promoting engineering excellence across the Global Digital Foundry.

Hybrid Role in Warsaw.

Summary Of Responsibilities

Support long-term solution architecture strategy, technology roadmaps, architecture principles, and technical standards across Fortrea's digital products and platforms.
Support enterprise architecture standards, reusable design patterns, reference architectures, architecture decision records (ADRs), engineering guardrails, and governance processes that promote consistency, scalability, maintainability, and reuse.
Support cloud-native architecture patterns utilizing Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, containers, serverless computing, API-first design, event-driven architectures, distributed systems, and modern software engineering practices.
Support solution architecture for digital products, SaaS platforms, APIs, integrations, mobile applications, cloud services, and shared engineering platforms.
Define enterprise AI architecture patterns supporting Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), vector databases, prompt orchestration, intelligent automation, and Responsible AI.
Partner with Data & AI teams to define reusable AI platform capabilities, enterprise AI governance, model integration strategies, and AI engineering standards.
Drive architecture modernization initiatives including cloud migration, platform engineering, application modernization, technical debt reduction, API modernization, microservices adoption, and platform consolidation.
Design reusable engineering platforms, shared services, Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs), developer enablement capabilities, and engineering accelerators that improve developer productivity.
Define enterprise integration strategies including API Management, event streaming, messaging, asynchronous architectures, interoperability frameworks, FHIR/HL7 integration (where applicable), and secure service communication.
Establish enterprise data architecture principles supporting Microsoft Fabric, cloud data platforms, analytics, data products, streaming architectures, governance, and enterprise data interoperability.
Lead architecture reviews, technical assessments, proof-of-concepts, design workshops, technology evaluations, and solution design activities.

Provide technical guidance to project teams and less-experienced colleagues by promoting software craftsmanship, engineering excellence, AI-assisted development, and architecture best practices.

Excellent communication, presentation, technical leadership, executive influence, and stakeholder management skills.

5+ years designing enterprise-scale SaaS platforms, digital products, APIs, cloud-native applications, distributed systems, and enterprise integrations.

Experience designing AI-enabled enterprise solutions using Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent automation, or machine learning services.

jobs.title: Industrial Data & AI Architect (M/F/NB)
jobs.description:
W Etteplan wierzymy, że skuteczne wdrożenie AI w przemyśle nie zaczyna się od modeli i algorytmów – zaczyna się od danych. Dobrze zaprojektowana architektura danych to fundament, bez którego żadne rozwiązanie AI nie będzie działać niezawodnie na poziomie operacyjnym.

W ramach strategii „Transformation with AI” budujemy zespół ekspertów, którzy pomagają organizacjom przemysłowym przejść od rozproszonych danych OT/IT do spójnych środowisk gotowych na analitykę, automatyzację i AI. Szukamy doświadczonego architekta, który poprowadzi ten obszar we współpracy z klientami i zespołami technicznymi Etteplan.

O zespole i środowisku pracy

Dołączysz do interdyscyplinarnego zespołu SES (Software & Embedded Solutions) w Polsce, który realizuje projekty cyfrowej transformacji dla klientów z sektorów produkcji, energetyki, farmaceutyki i infrastruktury krytycznej. Pracujemy z lokalnymi organizacjami oraz globalnymi klientami Etteplan w Europie Zachodniej i Skandynawii.

Jako Industrial Data & AI Architect będziesz działać na styku warstwy OT – systemów sterowania i automatyki – oraz IT, chmury i platform AI. Twoja praca tworzy fundament, na którym kolejne zespoły wdrażają rozwiązania analityczne, agentic AI i automatyzację procesów przemysłowych.

Twoja rola

Projektujesz i definiujesz architekturę danych dla środowisk przemysłowych – od poziomu urządzeń i systemów OT (PLC, SCADA, MES), przez warstwę integracji, aż po platformy chmurowe i usługi AI. Zapewniasz, że dane produkowane przez środowisko operacyjne klienta trafiają we właściwej jakości, latencji i strukturze tam, gdzie mogą realnie napędzać decyzje, usprawniać procesy oraz wspierać rozwój nowych produktów cyfrowych. To właśnie dzięki Twoim decyzjom architektonicznym dane z systemów przemysłowych stają się gotowe do wykorzystania w analityce, automatyzacji oraz rozwiązaniach AI wspierających działalność operacyjną klientów.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

projektowanie architektury danych dla środowisk przemysłowych – od warstwy OT po chmurę,
analizę i mapowanie przepływów danych pomiędzy systemami PLC, SCADA, MES, ERP oraz platformami chmurowymi,
dobór i projektowanie pipeline'ów danych (batch i streaming) z użyciem narzędzi takich jak dbt, Apache Spark, Kafka lub ich odpowiedników,
definiowanie strategii integracji i standardów zarządzania danymi (data governance, data quality, data contracts),
projektowanie środowisk danych pod potrzeby AI: feature stores, wektorowe bazy danych oraz przygotowanie danych do treningu i inferencji modeli,
współpracę z klientami przy definiowaniu wymagań architektonicznych i kierunku transformacji danych,
wsparcie działań pre-sales poprzez udział w warsztatach odkrywczych, przygotowywanie koncepcji technicznych oraz wycenę zakresu prac,
współpracę z AI Solution Architects i Agentic Workflow Engineers w celu zapewnienia spójności między architekturą danych a rozwiązaniami AI,
definiowanie dobrych praktyk i wzorców architektonicznych w obszarze danych przemysłowych.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz minimum 5 lat doświadczenia zawodowego, w tym doświadczenie w projektowaniu rozwiązań danych lub pełnieniu roli architekta/lead data engineera w środowiskach przemysłowych lub OT,
posiadasz praktyczną znajomość co najmniej jednej warstwy stosu przemysłowego: PLC/SCADA, MES lub ERP – i rozumiesz, jak dane przepływają między poziomami,
masz doświadczenie z narzędziami do przetwarzania i orkiestracji danych (np. Apache Spark, dbt, Airflow, Kafka lub podobne),
znasz co najmniej jedną platformę chmurową (Azure, AWS lub GCP) na poziomie projektowania rozwiązań danych,
potrafisz projektować architekturę z myślą o skalowalności, jakości danych i przyszłych potrzebach AI,
swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim, współpracując z klientami i zespołami w całej Europie,
potrafisz prowadzić rozmowy zarówno na poziomie technicznym (inżynierowie, architekci), jak i biznesowym (project ownerzy, managerowie),
dobrze odnajdujesz się w środowisku, w którym trzeba łączyć perspektywę klienta, biznesu i technologii,
myślisz architekturą i długofalowością rozwiązań, a nie wyłącznie doborem konkretnych narzędzi.

Docenimy również:

doświadczenie z platformami danych klasy enterprise: Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Delta Lake,
znajomość protokołów i standardów komunikacyjnych OT, takich jak OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus czy PROFINET,
doświadczenie z rozwiązaniami AI/ML, w tym wektorowymi bazami danych (np. Qdrant, Weaviate), MLflow lub feature stores,
znajomość architektur Data Lakehouse, Lambda lub Kappa,
doświadczenie w projektach Industry 4.0, IIoT lub związanych z cyfrowym bliźniakiem,
certyfikaty chmurowe (np. Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Data Analytics Specialty) lub związane z obszarem OT/security (ISA/IEC 62443),
znajomość języka niemieckiego umożliwiającą współpracę z klientami z regionu DACH.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

udział w projektach z zakresu digitalizacji przemysłu i AI przy użyciu najnowszych technologii
współpracę z interdyscyplinarnymi zespołami ekspertów w Polsce i za granicą,
przestrzeń do eksperymentowania i proponowania nowych podejść architektonicznych,

About the position

The Senior Cloud Engineer designs, implements, and evolves complex cloud infrastructure and automation solutions with a high degree of autonomy. This role owns systems and solutions that have significant impact on service reliability, security posture, and operational scalability. Senior Cloud Engineers act as technical leaders within the team, contributing to standards, mentoring peers, and supporting cross-functional initiatives.
The position can based in our Stockholm, we follow a hybrid work model with excellent flexible working practices. Applicants must hold a valid Right to Work in Sweden.

Responsibilities  

Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

Owns and evolves complex Infrastructure as Code solutions across the cloud environment
Makes independent design decisions within established architectural standards
Delivers improvements that enhance scalability, reliability, and team efficiency
Provides technical guidance and review for less senior engineers

Configuration

Designs and maintains complex configuration management solutions
Defines configuration patterns and best practices used across the environment
Reviews and guides configuration work performed by other engineers

Data Center Operations

Maintains an accurate and up-to-date inventory of all physical hardware within the data center, such as HSMs, USBs, Smartcards, SSDs and Shock-Proof cases. Informs supervisor when certain materials are running low.
Maintains detailed records of all data center operation activities, including changes to tamper evident bag numbers, incidents, and access to client materials. Follows proper procedures on strict guidelines for Root Signings, Disaster Recovery, CRLs and CSR signings. Ensures proper asset disposal procedures are followed.
Is able to follow documented procedures on how to properly handle sophisticated hardware security modules and KVM devices. Can perform configurations of the hardware security module and KVM with supervision from more senior peers.

Designs and builds advanced automation solutions using scripting, APIs, and Azure-native services
Drives automation initiatives that improve operational consistency and efficiency
Supports process improvement through tooling and automation

Networking

Applies deep knowledge of networking protocols and standards to support hosted services
Participates in compliance audits and provides technical input

Monitoring & Alerting

Defines and improves monitoring, alerting, and observability strategies
Ensures monitoring logic supports service reliability and rapid incident detection
Mentors peers on monitoring best practices

Patch Management

Leads patch management strategies and execution
Resolves escalated patching issues and drives process improvements
Contributes to the evolution of patching standards and practices

PKI Knowledge

Applies strong understanding of PKI concepts in support of customer and hosted environments
Performs PKI tasks for custom deployments
Contributes to strategy and design discussions for hosted PKI services
Produces technical documentation for PKI designs and processes
Participates in cross-functional certificate reviews

Product Knowledge

Serves as a subject matter expert on Keyfactor’s hosted products
Troubleshoots complex product issues across hosted environments
Participates in strategy and design discussions for new product offerings
Supports testing of new product versions and provides feedback to product teams
Interfaces with customers on hosted architecture and security posture when required

Minimum Qualifications, Education, and Skills  

High School Diploma or equivalent experience  
5+ years of related work experience and strong knowledge within their functional area
Expert-level knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including native services and tooling
Deep hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management tools
Advanced proficiency in PowerShell scripting (high complexity)
Extensive experience with Windows systems administration, including Windows Roles & Features
and Active Directory
Advanced problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues
Strong written and verbal communication skills with a professional demeanor
Strong organizational, time-management, and attention-to-detail skills
Proven ability to collaborate effectively within and across cross-functional teams
Self-motivated, able to manage complex work and projects to completion with minimal oversight
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Up to 15% travel time required

Salary will be commensurate with experience.

Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.

jobs.description:
Gothenburg or Lidköping; Hybrid

Airon.ai — next-generation AI infrastructure

Be part of building the systems that power the next generation of AI.

Why Airon, why now

Every wave of AI capability rests on the infrastructure beneath it. Airon is building that foundational layer — the compute and capacity that the world's most demanding AI workloads run on.

We are growing fast, working with sophisticated international enterprise customers and building the infrastructure required to support increasingly large and demanding AI workloads. This creates engineering challenges that are complex and evolving in real time.

This is a rare window to join. The market is being defined as we build, the technical decisions matter, and the engineers who join us now will have a real opportunity to shape our technology, architecture and engineering culture from the ground up.

Who we are

A tight-knit, high-energy team where people care about what they build, help each other out and have fun along the way.

We build, own and operate our own AI factories in Lidköping, Sweden, running on 100% renewable power, and sell dedicated bare-metal NVIDIA GPU compute to enterprise customers. Everything from the building to the platform is ours, which is why the engineering here is unusually broad.

The role

As AI Solutions Architect, you will be the technical authority in the room when we win strategic customers — and the person who makes sure what we sold is what we can actually deliver.

You will work hands-on with customer AI workloads, our compute platform and the designs that connect the two, taking ownership from first technical conversation through evaluation, proof of concept and onboarding. You will not simply execute against predefined specifications; you will help identify the right problems to solve and influence what we build.

You will work closely with our sales team, our platform and operations teams and our customers' engineers.

What you'll do

Own solutions end-to-end — from architecture and implementation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
Contribute to technical decisions and help shape our architecture, engineering principles and ways of working.
Improve the reliability, performance and scalability of our technology as the business grows.
Use AI and modern engineering tools to increase development speed, quality and operational efficiency.
Work alongside our sales team on strategic customers as the technical authority in the room.
Translate customer AI workloads — training, fine-tuning, inference — into concrete compute, network and storage designs on our platform.
Run technical evaluations, benchmarks and proofs of concept, and be honest about fit.
Turn recurring customer requirements into product and roadmap input for our engineering team.
Support onboarding of new customers together with operations, so what was promised is what gets delivered.

We believe you

Have worked hands-on with AI, ML or HPC workloads and understand what they actually need from infrastructure.
Can hold a technical conversation with a customer's engineers and a commercial one with their leadership, in the same meeting.
Have experience from a solutions architect, pre-sales, technical account or platform role facing external customers.
Write and present clearly in English and enjoy being the bridge between customer needs and what we build.
Are comfortable taking work from problem definition to a reliable, working solution.
Can make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, scalability, reliability, security and technical complexity.
Are comfortable working hands-on in an international, fast-moving environment.
Have a genuine interest in using AI and modern engineering tools to improve how software and infrastructure are built.

Bonus points for

NVIDIA GPU platforms and the CUDA ecosystem.
Distributed training at scale, and the failure modes that come with it.
Kubernetes, Slurm or comparable scheduling environments.
Understanding the economics of cloud versus bare-metal compute.
Experience of enterprise procurement and security review processes.
Experience from AI infrastructure, cloud infrastructure, data centers, distributed systems, high-performance computing or another relevant technical environment.
Experience working in an early-stage, high-growth or rapidly changing company.
Experience building systems that support enterprise customers or business-critical workloads.

Who you are

Curious and technically ambitious, with a genuine interest in understanding how things work.
Low-ego and action-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership.
Analytical and pragmatic, with the ability to turn complex problems into working solutions.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity.
Collaborative and direct, with the ability to communicate technical decisions clearly.
Motivated by solving difficult problems and building technology that matters.

What's in it for you

A chance to build the foundational infrastructure behind the next generation of AI — while the market and the technology are still taking shape.

You will work on complex, real-world engineering challenges with significant room to influence architecture, technical direction and how Airon builds. You will join early enough to make a visible impact, take meaningful ownership and help shape the engineering culture as the company scales.

If you have been looking for an engineering role where the problems are genuinely difficult, the pace is high and what you build has a direct impact — this is it.

Practical

Location: Gothenburg preferred; Lidköping or hybrid possible. Travel to customers expected.
We ask all candidates to consent to a background check before starting with us.

About Your Application

Send your application to career@airon.ai. Tell us a little about yourself, what you are great at and what you would like to build with us.

We know that great candidates do not always match every requirement on paper. If this opportunity excites you and you believe you could make an impact at Airon, we would still like to hear from you.

Ready to join us?

Help us build the infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description:
MongoDB is looking for an outstanding person to join our newly created Forward Deployed Engineering team and take on a key role in our extended R&D organization. Forward Deployed Engineering is linking the work of teams engaged on application modernization roles with our Product and Engineering teams.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

Many organizations have built up large estates of legacy applications. Lack of scalability and resilience, long development times, operating cost, and inability to run on cloud are common issues with these applications. To address these issues, organizations are engaging in large transformational Application Modernisation programs. MongoDB is recognized as the developer data platform of choice for transactional systems that provide the best scalability, resiliency and developer experience in the cloud as well as on premises. Organizations are continuously migrating workloads from these legacy applications to new platforms, often based on microservices, using MongoDB.

Such transformations are time intensive and often risky. Tooling based on generative AI promises to accelerate these transformations in a way never seen before. Forward Deployed Engineering is responsible for exploring the possibilities of Generative AI technologies and providing invaluable feedback to MongoDB’s R&D teams to drive future capabilities of MongoDB and the MongoDB ecosystem.

Application Modernization Engineers will work alongside project teams that are executing Application Modernisation projects with customers. The successful candidate will be responsible for evaluation, build, and applying tools in modernization projects, facilitating the usage of such tools and processes across the different project teams, identifying opportunities for tooling deployment, selecting potential 3rd party tools, contributing to the development of tooling prototypes and helping to shape the product roadmap.

Our ideal candidate will have

4+ years of experience as a field engineer or professional services consultant or full stack developer working directly with Enterprise clients
Proficiency in Java or C#, and some familiarity with common database access patterns and frameworks in one or more of these languages
Strong knowledge about enterprise-scale software architectures, application development methodologies, and software deployment and operations
Experience developing enterprise applications using relational databases, and employing SQL and stored procedures with Oracle, MS SQL Server, Sybase and/or PostgreSQL databases
Experience of using and developing with MongoDB and JSON based Document models is highly desirable
Problem solving skills, including the ability to collaborate across disciplines and teams to come up with creative solutions to technical and business challenges
Willingness to dive into a complex domain, ask the right questions, and bring new software tools and technologies to the table to solve customer problems
Great communication skills (both spoken and written), within the team and in customer meetings
Good understanding of Generative AI concepts, tools, and services. Any experience to build new applications/tools using Generative AI is a big plus. That includes Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini, and OpenAI APIs
And finally, a strong interest in how AI supported toolchains can improve application development

Position Expectations

Contribute to customer application modernization initiatives at any or all phases of the application lifecycle: assessment and analysis; planning and design; data modeling; application code conversion, development, test and build; integration and release configuration, production operations, application optimisation, and best practices adoption
Test drive MongoDB migration products to deliver on customer use cases and drive adoption of the product. Deliver concise feedback to the rest of the development organisation
Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to influence the direction of the MongoDB product roadmap
Personally execute POCs including developing or extending existing tools when necessary and appropriate for customer success, with an eye towards reusability and eventual integration with our products. These are often on premises at client locations
Maintain a broad and deep technical understanding of the product line and the underlying technologies and protocols
Work as part of a wider delivery team comprising consulting engineers from MongoDB Professional Services, project managers, and account teams
Assist sales teams in evaluating opportunities with prospects and customers
Willingness to work on site with customers for 7 days per month, which includes regional travel (within Europe)

Success Measures

The Senior Forward Deployed Engineer will be successful in this role when they can execute the following strategic tasks/responsibilities:

Become an expert level user of MongoDB, and our tools current migration products
Develop a playbook for customer application modernization engagements, in collaboration with other MongoDB Engineers, Product Management and Engineering
Communicate complex technical proposals simply and convincingly to a wide range of audiences
Provide unique insight into customer needs, product requirements and strategic opportunities by contributing experience from the field
Gain the reputation as a trusted advisor with our field teams and customers
Contribute to the success of customer application migration initiatives that they support

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
AI Architect role.

We're looking for a hands-on architect who understands what it takes to bring AI into a company successfully, safely, at scale and at speed. In short: you help us move fast without breaking things. You own the build-and-validate phase; a separate team takes proven PoCs to production. Ideal for a solutions architect who's as comfortable coding a prototype as shaping architecture decisions and bringing stakeholders along.

What you'll do:

Build PoCs with the team, then take the proven ones to production or write the spec for the team that will run them.
Solve real problems, finding the pain points, design the fix, ship it and prove the value.
Design for scale where every PoC fits our wider IT landscape and Enterprise Architecture.
Own the architecture that lets AutoStore build AI solutions safely across the company.
Work with the IT teams already building our foundations (data, integration, security, authentication and hosting). You define what AI needs from them and build on top of what they deliver.
Bring people along by explaining choices and trade-offs in plain language, to developers and business leaders alike.

Who you are:

An experienced builder with full-stack developer background.
As comfortable writing code for a prototype as you are making architecture decisions.
You know how data, integration, security and hosting fit together in a large organization.
Nice to have: experience with Azure, Databricks, or taking AI solutions into production.

You'll join a small, empowered team with one task: figure out how to get the most out of AI in what we think is Norway's coolest tech company. (TIME named our robots one of the Best Inventions of 2025, so we're not the only ones who think so.)

AutoStore already builds AI into its products. Now we want to put it to work across the whole company. There is no finished map for this, so we will make the path by walking it. We prototype fast, work closely with the business, and build together with the rest of our exceptional IT team. You'll sit close to the people who do the work, find where AI makes the biggest difference, and build the solutions that prove it. We measure success in business value, not in slides.

How We Work

Think big, start small, move fast. An idea should become a working prototype in weeks, not months.
Build, test, kill, build again. We kill our darlings early, so the best ideas get our time.
Built to grow. We build on our Azure Databricks data platform and follow our IT and enterprise architecture, so what works can scale.
Proven ideas move on. When a prototype proves its value, we take it to production or hand it over to the team that will run it. Then we pick the next problem.
Share what we learn. What we learn at the bleeding edge, we share with the rest of AutoStore as we scale up.

Location: Oslo, Stavanger, or Nedre Vats.

We Offer:

A Collaborative and Inclusive Culture where we celebrate and value everyone’s contributions, encouraging diverse perspectives in decision-making.
Work-Life Balance & Well-being: We offer 1 hour per week of paid exercise, health insurance, and a generous pension plan, prioritizing your mental and physical well-being.
A Creative and Safe Workplace by joining a company experiencing rapid growth, with the stability of being Norway’s first unicorn listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.
International and Supportive Environment within a Norwegian multinational that values collaboration and innovation.

Application deadline: October 11th
. Please note that we review applications continuously—if this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply as early as possible! All inquiries are treated confidentially.

If you are applying from outside of Norway please indicate that you will be relocating to be considered.

AutoStore does not accept agency resumes or assistance for this role. Please do not forward resumes to our job's alias or AutoStore employees. AutoStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. This policy should be respected.
