jobs.title: Azure Integration Architect / Presales Architect
jobs.description:
Innostutko asiakkaiden liiketoimintahaasteiden ratkaisemisesta moderneilla integraatio- ja pilvipalveluratkaisuilla? Viihdytkö liiketoiminnan, arkkitehtuurin ja asiakastyön rajapinnassa?

Sijainti: Suomi
Kokemustaso: Mid/Senior

Etsimme kokenutta Azure-integraatioarkkitehtia vahvistamaan Solitan integraatioliiketoimintaa Suomessa.

Roolin kuvaus

Tässä roolissa toimit asiakkaidemme luotettuna neuvonantajana ja osallistut integraatio- ja pilviratkaisujen suunnitteluun aina ensimmäisistä asiakaskeskusteluista toteutukseen asti.
Työssä korostuvat asiakkaiden kanssa työskentely sekä myynnin tukeminen. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, myynnin ja teknisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa ymmärtääksesi asiakkaan liiketoimintahaasteet ja muuntaaksesi ne toimiviksi, skaalautuviksi ja turvallisiksi Azure-pohjaisiksi ratkaisuiksi. Pystyt keskustelemaan sujuvasti liiketoimintajohdon kanssa asiakkaan tavoitteista ja haasteista sekä syventymään teknisiin ratkaisuihin arkkitehtien ja kehittäjien kanssa.

Integraatioarkkitehtina mahdollistat älykkään, turvallisen ja liiketoimintaa tukevan järjestelmien yhteentoimivuuden. Suunnittelet ja toteutat integraatioratkaisuja, joiden avulla data ja prosessit liikkuvat saumattomasti organisaation sisällä ja ekosysteemien välillä. Roolissasi yhdistyvät pitkäjänteinen arkkitehtuurityö, toimitusten sparraus sekä AI-avusteisten toimintamallien hyödyntäminen integraatioiden suunnittelussa, toteutuksessa, laadunvarmistuksessa ja dokumentoinnissa.

Johdat teknistä visiota siitä, kuinka järjestelmät kommunikoivat skaalautuvasti, hallitusti ja turvallisesti. Valitset sopivat integraatiomallit, teknologiat ja toimintatavat, määrittelet arkkitehtuuriperiaatteet ja varmistat, että ratkaisut tukevat sekä nykyisiä liiketoimintatarpeita että pidemmän aikavälin IT-strategiaa. Samalla huolehdit siitä, että integraatioiden operoitavuus, laatu, dokumentaatio ja hallintamallit ovat kestävällä pohjalla.

Keskitymme moderneihin API-ratkaisuihin, pilvipohjaisiin integraatioihin ja automaatioon valiten aina asiakkaalle parhaiten sopivat työkalut. Laatu ja parhaat käytännöt ohjaavat kaikkea tekemistämme, ja hyödynnämme aktiivisesti tekoälyä kehitystyön tehostamiseksi ja entistä parempien ratkaisujen tuottamiseksi.

Keskeisiä integraatioteknologioitamme ovat Azure, MuleSoft, Apache Camel. Työskentelemme myös Workaton ja Kafkan parissa. Meillä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisissa projekteissa sekä julkisella että yksityisellä sektorilla.

Kokemuksestasi ja vastuutasostasi riippuen kuukausipalkka tässä roolissa on 5 200–6 200 euroa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Vahva kokemus integraatioarkkitehtuurista ja yritystason integraatioratkaisuista
Kokemusta Microsoft Azure -ympäristöjen suunnittelusta ja hyödyntämisestä
Kykyä toimia sekä liiketoiminnan että teknisten sidosryhmien kanssa
Kokemusta työpajojen, vaatimusmäärittelyjen ja asiakaskeskustelujen fasilitoinnista
Ymmärrystä tekoälyn ja AI-agenttien hyödyntämisestä osana yritysarkkitehtuuria, integraatioita tai liiketoimintaprosesseja.
Erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja esiintymistaitoja suomeksi ja englanniksi
Kykyä muuntaa asiakkaan liiketoimintahaasteet konkreettisiksi teknisiksi ratkaisuiksi
Kokemusta myynnin tukemisesta ratkaisusuunnittelun, tarjousten ja asiakastapaamisten kautta
Ymmärrystä API-arkkitehtuureista, tapahtumapohjaisista ratkaisuista ja pilvinatiiveista integraatiomalleista
Konsultoivaa työotetta ja kykyä rakentaa luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita

Katsomme lisäksi eduksi

Kokemus Azure Integration Services -ratkaisuista
Kokemus API Management -alustoista
Ymmärrys data-, analytiikka- ja AI-ratkaisujen integraatiotarpeista
Kokemus laajojen arkkitehtuurikokonaisuuksien tai muutoshankkeiden johtamisesta
Microsoft Azure -sertifioinnit

Huomioithan, että useat asiakasprojektimme edellyttävät sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

Millainen henkilö menestyy tässä roolissa?

Viihdyt asiakkaiden kanssa ja nautit teknologian, liiketoiminnan sekä uusien mahdollisuuksien tunnistamisen yhdistämisestä.
Osaat keskustella asiakkaan johdon kanssa liiketoiminnan tavoitteista ja haasteista sekä toisaalta sparrata kehittäjiä ja arkkitehteja teknisissä ratkaisuissa. Näet arkkitehtuurin keinona luoda liiketoiminta-arvoa, et pelkästään teknisinä piirustuksina.
Olet oma-aloitteinen, kaupallisesti ajatteleva ja motivoidut asiakkaiden onnistumisesta sekä Solitan liiketoiminnan kasvattamisesta.

Miksi viihtyisit meillä?

Asiantuntijayhteisö

Osaajayhteisömme tarjoaa mahdollisuuden jatkuvaan oppimiseen ja ammatilliseen kehittymiseen. Arvostamme yhteistyötä ja vahvaa yhteisöllisyyttä projektien ja asiakkaiden välillä. Se on yksi tärkeimmistä syistä siihen, miksi ihmiset viihtyvät tiimissämme.
Vapautta ja joustavuutta

Solitalla työ mukautuu elämääsi, ei päinvastoin. Voit työskennellä mistä päin Suomea tahansa ja meillä on joustava etätyöpolitiikka, asiakastarve huomioiden.
Kattavat edut

Voit valita omat työvälineesi, hyödyntää laajaa työterveyshuoltoa, käyttää hierontaetua, pyöräetua, saada tukea sisäisiltä valmentajiltamme sekä osallistua erilaisiin harrastuskerhoihimme.
Kiinteä kuukausipalkka

Kannustamme oppimiseen, osaamisen kehittämiseen, yhteistyöhön ja tiedon jakamiseen ilman laskutusasteeseen perustuvaa palkitsemismallia.
Mahdollisuuksia kasvaa

Solita Growth Academy, mentorointi ja mahdollisuus siirtyä erilaisiin projekteihin tarjoavat jatkuvia mahdollisuuksia ammatilliseen kehittymiseen.
Vaikuttavia asiakasprojekteja

Olemme esimerkiksi auttaneet metsäkonevalmistaja Ponssea tehostamaan toimintaansa ja kasvattamaan palveluliiketoimintaansa toimittamalla modernin pilvipohjaisen data-alustan sekä integraatiot useisiin tietolähteisiin.

Haluatko liittyä Solitan integraatioyhteisöön?

Jos tämä kuulostaa sinulle sopivalta mahdollisuudelta, lähetä meille CV:si, LinkedIn-profiilisi tai hakemuksesi. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Saila Karonen (saila.karonen@solita.fi).

Keskeisenä teknologia-, data- ja designkumppanina Solitan liiketoiminta perustuu luottamukseen ja vastuullisuuteen. Tästä syystä valitun hakijan henkilöllisyys ja työhistoria tarkistetaan. Nämä tarkastukset suoritetaan työelämän yksityisyyden suojasta annetun lain mukaisesti ja sen rajoissa.
Tässä tehtävässä työskentely voi edellyttää asiakkaamme pyynnöstä tehtävää turvallisuusselvitystä. Turvallisuusselvitys toteutetaan turvallisuusselvityslain mukaisesti, ja sen hyväksytty läpäiseminen on tehtävässä työskentelyn edellytys.

jobs.title: Experienced Software Developer
jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help us shape the next generation of development at Dalux.

You will work on products used by professionals around the world, contribute to architectural and technical decisions, and have the opportunity to influence not only what we build, but also how we build it.

Increasingly, this means thinking about how we use AI to make software development more effective.

Your role

As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will work as part of a product team together with other developers, a Product Manager, and a Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks: helping make good technical decisions, improving the codebase and architecture, sharing knowledge, and raising the engineering standard around them.

Depending on your experience and interests, your work can include:

Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end
Designing and implementing scalable, maintainable solutions
Contributing to architectural decisions and technical direction
Identifying and addressing technical debt where it creates meaningful value
Improving engineering practices, tools, and developer workflows
Driving or contributing to initiatives around infrastructure as code, DevOps, CI/CD, architecture, or developer tooling
Sparring with and mentoring other developers
Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions
Bringing new ideas and technologies into Dalux when they can improve our products or development practices

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

AI-assisted software development

We are significantly increasing our focus on AI-assisted development across Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can improve the software development lifecycle – from understanding requirements and exploring technical approaches to coding, testing, review, debugging, refactoring, and automation.

We do not see AI as a replacement for strong engineering fundamentals. We see it as a tool that can make capable developers more effective when combined with technical judgment and a clear understanding of the problem being solved.

As an experienced developer, we want you to take an active role in this development: experimenting with new workflows, critically evaluating their value, sharing what works, and helping us establish good engineering practices around AI-assisted development.

Practical experience using AI as part of your development workflow is an advantage. More importantly, you should be curious about how these tools are changing software engineering and willing to continue developing your own way of working.

Technologies we work with

Our platform is built on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS.

Our primary technologies include:

C# / .NET
Angular / TypeScript
GitHub CoPilot
MSSQL
Elasticsearch
AWS
Optionally, Android / iOS development using .NET MAUI

You may also encounter parts of our C++ codebase, including opportunities to modernize and improve existing solutions.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

Product development at Dalux

Our product teams bring developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers together.

Developers are expected to understand the problem being solved and contribute to finding the solution – not simply implement specifications handed to them.

As an experienced developer, you will have an important voice in balancing user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

Your background

We expect that you:

Have solid professional software development experience
Hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related technical field
Have strong software engineering fundamentals
Are comfortable owning complex technical problems and decisions
Care about maintainability, reliability, performance, and quality
Can navigate and improve an established codebase and architecture
Enjoy technical sparring and sharing knowledge with other developers
Are proactive and willing to challenge existing approaches when you see a better solution
Understand the trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term technical quality
Are interested in how AI and new development tools can improve your effectiveness as an engineer

Experience with C#/.NET, Angular, cloud development, or AI-assisted development is an advantage, but we do not expect you to match every technology we use.

What You Can Expect From Dalux

Dalux is a software company at heart.

As an experienced developer, you can expect:

Significant ownership of the software you build
Real influence on technical solutions and engineering practices
Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussion and constructive challenge
Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design
Short paths from technical ideas to decisions and implementation
Opportunities to drive improvements beyond your immediate product work
An environment actively investing in AI-assisted software development
High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems
A social workplace with monthly events and employee-driven clubs

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

About Dalux

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

Interested?

Hos Nomeco sørger vi for rettidig adgang til livsvigtig medicin samt tilbyder effektive logistikløsninger til medicinalindustrien i Norden.
Vi er stolte af at være en central del af sundhedssystemets infrastruktur og en pålidelig nordisk partner for industrien med løsninger, der spænder fra lagerstyring til levering.
Som Danmarks førende lægemiddelgrossist og strategisk partner for både apoteker og hospitaler, er vi "the heartbeat of healthcare”. Lige nu er vi 950 medarbejdere, der holder hjertet i gang – og der er plads til dig på holdet.

Dine opgaver, rollen og teamet

Som AI Solutions Developer bliver du en del af Data, Analytics & AI. Vi er et team på otte, der dækker BI og analytics, data engineering samt AI og automatisering, og du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores Data Scientist & Power Apps Specialist samt kolleger på tværs af IT og forretningen.

Du bliver central i at accelerere udviklingen af AI-assistenter, agentiske løsninger og AI-understøttede processer. Rollen spænder fra prototyper i Microsoft Copilot Studio til produktionsmodne pro-code løsninger på Azure. Du skal kunne tage ansvar for hele vejen fra forretningsbehov og prototype til sikker, testbar, dokumenteret og driftsklar løsning.

Vi har allerede AI-løsninger i drift og investerer aktivt i at skalere anvendelsen af AI på tværs af organisationen. Du kommer derfor ind i en organisation, hvor AI er en strategisk prioritet, og hvor der er konkrete løsninger, use cases og forretningsområder at bygge videre på.

Du får mulighed for både at udvikle nye løsninger, videreudvikle eksisterende initiativer og præge vores tekniske standarder og fælles tilgang til AI-agenter.

Identificere og kvalificere AI-use cases sammen med forretningen
Udvikle AI-agenter og assistenter i Microsoft Copilot Studio
Udvikle pro-code AI-løsninger og agentiske workflows på Microsoft/Azure tech stack

Bidrage til fælles AI-arkitektur, governance og ansvarlig anvendelse af AI samt hjælpe organisationen med at opbygge praktisk AI-kompetence

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du har praktisk erfaring med softwareudvikling og generativ AI, og at du motiveres af at omsætte komplekse teknologier til enkle og værdiskabende løsninger. Du arbejder eksperimenterende, men har samtidig blik for sikkerhed, kvalitet og drift.

Kan omsætte et forretningsproblem til en afgrænset AI-løsning og tage ansvar for vejen fra prototype til stabil drift
Har erfaring med softwareudvikling i eksempelvis Python, C# eller TypeScript
Har arbejdet praktisk med generativ AI, LLM’er eller AI-assistenter
Har erfaring med API'er og MCP
Forstår principper for grounding, RAG og integration af AI-agenter med data, API’er og handlinger.
Har erfaring med Git, test og CI/CD
Kommunikerer tydeligt med både udviklere, ledere og procesejere

Det er en fordel, hvis du også har erfaring med:

Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Power Apps eller Dataverse
Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI eller øvrige Azure AI-services
Evaluering og monitorering af AI-løsninger
GitHub Copilot og AI-understøttede udviklingsmetoder

Som person er du nysgerrig og løsningsorienteret, og du tager ansvar for, at det, du bygger, fungerer i praksis. Du trives med at arbejde tæt sammen med forretningen, udfordre behov konstruktivt og finde den enkleste løsning, der skaber reel værdi.

jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
At Siteimprove, we are the leader in agentic content intelligence. Siteimprove.ai is a unified platform that brings together accessibility, analytics, SEO/AEO, and content strategy into a single, continuous flow. Our AI agents work alongside marketing and digital teams—not instead of them—helping create high-performing, accessible content that's easy to discover by both humans and AI.

As our Senior Engineering Manager for the Search Insights team
, you will lead a distributed engineering team of ~7 engineers responsible for one of our core capabilities: SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
. Your team owns the foundations of enterprise search performance—tracking rankings, monitoring technical SEO health, and proving search impact through clear reporting and actionable insights for enterprise marketing teams.

This role requires a technical leader who can flex both engineering and management muscles
. You'll provide architectural oversight and technical decision-making while leading your team through the evolution from traditional SEO to the emerging world of Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), where visibility extends beyond Google to AI-powered platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews.

You will play a pivotal role in modernizing our technical approaches, evolving codebases and integrated technology platforms, and establishing patterns for delivery excellence. If you're passionate about leading engineers, solving complex technical challenges, and delivering measurable customer value, this role is for you!

What We Will Be Doing

Technical Leadership and Vision - Provide hands-on technical leadership and architectural oversight for the Search Insights team. Collaborate with engineers to build solid technical strategy, drive adoption of service-oriented architectures, and modernize approaches across our .NET, TypeScript, React, and AWS stack.
End-to-End Delivery - Own the team's end-to-end delivery, ensuring timely execution of the development lifecycle from concept to launch while meeting business goals. Establish and maintain patterns for delivery excellence across a distributed team.
Team Leadership and Development - Lead, mentor, and develop a team of ~7 engineers including both full-time employees and long-term contractors. Hire and manage engineering performance, fostering a collaborative, high-performing team culture across time zones.
Product Partnership - Partner closely with Product Management to own the product roadmap and delivery outcomes. Ensure the team delivers true customer value by translating business requirements into technical solutions that prove SEO impact through clear reporting and metrics.
Cross-Functional Collaboration - Partner with product teams across the Search Pillar (including Content Optimization), other platform pillars (Accessibility, Analytics, Content Strategy), data science and AI teams, and go-to-market teams to deliver innovative search features that drive measurable outcomes for enterprise customers.
Technical Modernization - Modernize existing Siteimprove codebases and integrate acquired technology platforms. Drive adoption of industry-standard patterns and open-source solutions over bespoke technologies.
Data-Driven Decision-Making - Leverage data insights to prioritize features and enhancements that help customers monitor indexability, site structure, content discoverability, and search performance across traditional and AI-powered search experiences.

Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, architectural oversight, and hands-on technical involvement when needed.
Experience hiring, developing, and managing engineering performance across distributed teams.
Track record of partnering with Product Management to own roadmaps and deliver customer outcomes.
Strong analytical skills, using data to guide technical and business decisions.
Excellent communication and leadership abilities across cross-functional teams and time zones.

Experience managing teams in search technology, SEO platforms, or marketing SaaS products.
Background in technical modernization efforts, legacy system migration, or platform consolidation.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
Understanding of AI/ML applications in search ranking, answer engine optimization, or content discovery.
Experience managing mixed teams of full-time employees and contractors.
Proficient with software development tools and platforms (e.g., Jira, AWS).
Strong understanding of modern software architecture patterns, particularly microservices and service-oriented design.
Experience with cloud infrastructure and DevOps practices.

What you'll love about us

We’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

jobs.title: Azure Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Om dit kommende job

Fellowmind Managed Platform – FMP – er vores fælles platform til standardiseret, sikker og effektiv håndtering af kundernes Azure-miljøer. Platformen kombinerer automatisering, governance og managed services i en skalerbarløsning, der løbende udvikles i takt med kundernes behov og Microsofts teknologier.

Som Azure Platform Engineer bliver du en del af hele platformens livscyklus. Du kommer både til at onboarde nye kunder, implementere løsninger og bidrage til den løbende udvikling og drift af platformen.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med kunder, konsulenter, arkitekter og resten af FMP-teamet. Du får gradvist mere indflydelse i takt med, at du lærer platformen, kunderne og vores arbejdsmetoder at kende.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

Onboarding af nye kunder og deres Azure-miljøer på FMP
Implementering og konfiguration af platformskomponenter
Automatisering af deployment, konfiguration og driftsopgaver
Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af Infrastructure as Code
Fejlsøgning og håndtering af tekniske problemstillinger
Test, dokumentation og kvalitetssikring af løsninger
Deltagelse i dialogen med kunder om behov og mulige løsninger
Bidrag til videreudvikling af FMP’s funktionalitet, værktøjer og standarder

Sådan arbejder vi

FMP-teamet arbejder efter principperne i Golazo. Vi deler arbejdet op i mindre, værdiskabende leverancer og afstemmer tilgang og design, før vi går i gang med implementeringen.

Vi betragter ikke en opgave som færdig, blot fordi teknikken virker. Test, dokumentation, monitorering og validering hos kunden er en del af leverancen.

Du behøver ikke kende Golazo på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde struktureret, gøre dit arbejde synligt og give og modtage konstruktiv feedback.

Om teamet

Du bliver en del af vores Cloud, Security & Operations-team og får din daglige gang i det tværfaglige team omkring FMP.

Teamet består af konsulenter og arkitekter med forskellige faglige styrker inden for blandt andet Azure, automatisering, sikkerhed, softwareudvikling og managed services. Vi arbejder på tværs af Fellowminds lokationer og lande oglægger stor vægt på samarbejde, fælles ejerskab og videndeling.

Du får mulighed for at lære af erfarne kolleger og samtidig sætte dit eget præg på platformen og vores måde at arbejde på.

Om dine kompetencer

Der kan være flere veje ind i rollen. Du kan eksempelvis have en baggrund som cloud- eller infrastrukturkonsulent, DevOps engineer, platform engineer eller udvikler med interesse for Azure.

Vi forestiller os at du

Har en teknisk nysgerrighed og et solidt fundament inden for cloudteknologier. Du har praktisk erfaring med Azure eller lignende cloudplatforme og har arbejdet med automatisering, scripting eller Infrastructure as Code. Samtidig har du forståelse for centrale områder som sikkerhed, governance og stabil drift, og du trives med at analysere tekniske problemstillinger og arbejde struktureret frem mod holdbare løsninger.

Du er vant til at dokumentere dit arbejde og dele viden med dine kolleger, og du kan arbejde selvstændigt inden for klare rammer. Derudover motiveres du af at kombinere produktudvikling med konkrete kundeopgaver, hvor du kan omsætte teknologi til værdi. Du kommunikerer professionelt og ubesværet på både dansk og engelsk.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med:

Azure landing zones, governance og identitetsstyring med Azure Policy, RBAC og Microsoft Entra ID
Infrastructure as Code med eksempelvis Bicep, Terraform eller tilsvarende teknologier
Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD samt automatisering med PowerShell, Azure CLI eller lignende værktøjer
Monitorering, logging og observability samt kendskab til Cloud Adoption Framework, Well-Architected Framework eller drift af cloudplatforme

Vi forventer ikke, at du allerede kan det hele. Det vigtigste er, at du har et godt teknisk fundament, er nysgerrig og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med platformen og teamet.

Om dig

Du går op i kvalitet og tager ansvar for, at dine leverancer fungerer i praksis. Du er nysgerrig, opsøger ny viden og spørger om hjælp, når det skaber et bedre resultat.

Du trives med at arbejde i et team, hvor løsninger bliver kvalificeret gennem dialog og review. Du kan stå på egne ben, men holder ikke viden eller udfordringer for dig selv.

Samtidig har du blik for, at den bedste tekniske løsning ikke nødvendigvis er den mest avancerede. Den skal være forståelig, driftsvenlig og skabe reel værdi for kunden.

Om dit kommende job

Fellowmind Managed Platform er vores fælles platform til standardiseret, sikker og effektiv håndtering af kundernes Azure-miljøer. Platformen kombinerer automatisering, governance og managed services i en skalerbarløsning, der løbende udvikles i takt med kundernes behov og Microsofts teknologier.

Som Senior Azure Architect får du en central rolle i platformens tekniske udvikling. Du bliver medansvarlig for, at FMP har en tydelig arkitektur, kan skaleres på tværs af kunder og samtidig er sikker, driftsvenlig og enkel at videreudvikle.

Du arbejder både strategisk og hands-on. Du skal kunne drive en designproces og træffe tekniske beslutninger, men også være tæt nok på implementeringen til at sikre, at arkitekturen fungerer i praksis.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

Sætte teknisk retning for FMP og omsætte den til konkrete, prioriterede forbedringer
Designe standardiserede og skalerbare løsninger på tværs af kundemiljøer
Drive teknisk afklaring og udarbejde korte, præcise designdokumenter
Sikre sammenhæng mellem arkitektur, sikkerhed, governance, drift og kundeoplevelse
Kvalificere komplekse kundekrav og omsætte dem til genanvendelige funktioner og services
Foretage tekniske reviews og sikre kvalitet i design og implementering
Identificere teknisk gæld, risici og muligheder for automatisering
Understøtte onboarding af komplekse kunder og håndtere tekniske eskalationer
Sparre med kunder, arkitekter og interne interessenter om roadmap og løsningsvalg
Mentorere kolleger og bidrage til at løfte teamets tekniske niveau
Skabe fælles standarder, dokumentation og beslutningsgrundlag
Bidrage aktivt til implementering, fejlsøgning og proof of concepts, når opgaven kræver det

Sådan arbejder vi

FMP-teamet arbejder efter principperne i Golazo. Det betyder blandt andet, at vi skaber fælles kontekst, før vi implementerer, begrænser mængden af igangværende arbejde og prioriterer små leverancer, der hurtigt kan valideres.

I rollen får du et særligt ansvar for, at designafklaringen har den rette kvalitet. Det handler ikke om at producere tunge arkitekturdokumenter, men om at gøre mål, afhængigheder, risici, test og væsentlige beslutninger tydelige, mensdet stadig er billigt at ændre retning.

Du bliver ikke den eneste, der må træffe tekniske beslutninger. En vigtig del af rollen er netop at skabe rammer, viden og fælles principper, så teamet kan tage et bredere teknisk ejerskab.

Om teamet

Du bliver en del af vores Cloud, Security & Operations-team og får en central rolle i det tværfaglige team omkring FMP.

Teamet består af konsulenter og arkitekter med forskellige faglige styrker inden for Azure, automatisering, sikkerhed, softwareudvikling og managed services. Vi arbejder på tværs af Fellowminds lokationer og lande, og platformensbeslutninger skal derfor kunne fungere i flere organisatoriske og kundemæssige sammenhænge.

Vi lykkes som team og forventer, at du bidrager med både teknisk retning og plads til andres perspektiver. Rollen handler ikke om at være den person, der har alle svarene, men om at hjælpe teamet med at stille de rigtige spørgsmålog træffe holdbare beslutninger.

Om dine komptencer

Vi forestiller os, at du har en solid baggrund inden for Azure, cloudarkitektur eller platform engineering og har erfaring med at tage teknisk ansvar for løsninger, der skal være robuste, sikre og skalerbare over tid. Du har arbejdet hands-on med Azure-platformen og designet arkitekturer, hvor sikkerhed, governance, drift og fleksibilitet har været centrale hensyn. Samtidig er du komfortabel med Infrastructure as Code, automatisering og CI/CD og ser værdien i at bygge platforme, der er enkle at vedligeholde og nemme at videreudvikle.

Som person er du i stand til at omsætte komplekse forretningsmæssige og tekniske krav til en klar teknisk retning. Du kan hurtigt identificere de væsentligste risici og afvejninger i en løsning og træffe velbegrundede beslutninger på den baggrund. Derudover formår du at kommunikere arkitektur og tekniske valg på en måde, der giver mening for både specialister, kunder og beslutningstagere.

Det er også vigtigt for os, at du trives i en rolle, hvor du gør andre bedre. Du har erfaring med faglig sparring, tekniske reviews eller mentoring og motiveres af at dele viden og skabe retning uden selv at blive en flaskehals for teamet. Du arbejder godt i krydsfeltet mellem langsigtet platformudvikling og konkrete kundeopgaver, hvor du både bidrager strategisk og får tingene til at ske i praksis.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har dyb erfaring med flere af følgende områder:

Azure landing zones og platformarkitektur
Azure Policy, management groups, RBAC og Microsoft Entra ID
Bicep, Terraform eller tilsvarende Infrastructure as Code
Azure DevOps, Git, branchingstrategier og CI/CD
Platform engineering og self-service-koncepter
Security by design og Zero Trust
Monitorering, logging, observability og incident management
Cloud Adoption Framework og Well-Architected Framework
FinOps og optimering af cloudforbrug
Produktudvikling eller udvikling af fælles platformskapabiliteter

Om dig

Du tager ansvar for helheden og interesserer dig både for den tekniske løsning, teamets arbejdsgang og den værdi, kunden oplever.

Du kan træffe beslutninger, når det er nødvendigt, men er samtidig nysgerrig på andres perspektiver. Du bruger review og faglig uenighed til at forbedre løsningen frem for til at forsvare dit eget forslag.

Du er pragmatisk og kan skelne mellem beslutninger, der kræver grundig afklaring, og detaljer, der med fordel kan vente. Du ved også, at en arkitektur først har værdi, når teamet kan forstå, implementere og drive den.

jobs.title: Manager, Microsoft Agents & Power Platform CoE
jobs.description:
Manager, Microsoft Agents & Power Platform CoE (30000026)

Why this role matters

If you enjoy building high‑quality digital and AI‑enabled solutions, guiding teams through complex automation choices, and helping an organisation scale these capabilities responsibly, this role is for you. This role sits within Changi Airport Group’s (CAG) human resource function and our mission is to attract and retain talents, build sustained capabilities and create an inspiring workplace.

Heading upthe Microsoft Agents & Power Platform Centre of Excellence (MAPP CoE)
at Changi Airport Group (CAG), you will lead a specialist team that designs, builds, and maintains Microsoft‑native automation and AI agent solutions
. This includes Power Automate flows, Power Apps, Copilot Studio (Full) agents, and Azure AI‑based agent solutions.

Your role sits at the intersection of business intent, technical feasibility, and platform quality
. You will lead engineers and Business Analysts (BAs) to help CAG teams automate real work — pragmatically, securely, and at scale — while keeping the Power Platform and Copilot Agents ecosystem robust, well‑governed, and trusted.

You will lead the MAPP CoE to:
1. Build and operate Microsoft‑native AI agents and automation solutions

Design, build, deploy, and maintain task‑specific Copilot Studio agents, Power Automate workflows, Power Apps, and Azure AI agent solutions, with increasing emphasis on agent‑first and headless designs where appropriate.
Ensure solutions integrate securely with enterprise data sources, Microsoft 365 services, and downstream systems.
Remain accountable for solution quality, including reliability, performance, security, and long‑term maintainability, across all assets built or supported by the MAPP CoE.

2. Establish strong lifecycle management for agents and automation

Put in place disciplined practices for versioning, testing, monitoring, and safely enhancing or retiring agents and automated workflows.
Anticipate and manage agent‑specific failure modes such as partial execution, ambiguous outputs, and timely escalation to humans.
Ensure solutions are production‑ready, auditable, and operable over time — not just technically impressive or experimental.

3. Act as the practical guardian of quality, standards, and governance

Work closely with platform owners and Microsoft 365 administrators to shape and refine practical governance controls that safely enable Power Platform and Copilot Agents adoption across CAG.
Contribute hands‑on technical insight to platform governance discussions, helping identify appropriate guardrails, controls, and enablement mechanisms.
Define, promulgate, and uphold best development practices, quality standards, and design guidelines for Power Platform and Copilot agent solutions.
Ensure governance expectations are translated into everyday delivery practices and solution designs within the MAPP CoE.

4. Lead a Business Analyst team that shapes solutions at the front line

Lead and develop a team of Business Analysts who partner closely with business teams.
Ensure BAs can challenge problem statements, guide teams through automation and agent decision architectures, and design sound solution approaches.
Build strong BA capability in translating business needs into clear, implementable solution designs for engineers.
Help BAs stay current with Microsoft agent and Power Platform capabilities so they can confidently advise on what is possible, appropriate, and premature.

5. Enable employees to self‑build simple digital and agentic solutions

Design and deliver practical enablement through brown bags, clinics, playbooks, and consultations to help employees self‑build simple Power Automate flows and Copilot Chat / Lite agents.
Clearly distinguish between solutions that can be safely self‑built by employees and those that should be built and maintained by the MAPP CoE (e.g. Power Apps, Copilot Studio agents, Azure AI agents).
Focus enablement on building understanding of possibilities, limits, and good practices — not on turning non‑technical staff into full‑stack developers.

6. Drive value realisation and impact storytelling

Put in place practical systems to measure, track, and monitor the impact delivered by MAPP CoE solutions on an ongoing basis.
Track both quantitative and qualitative outcomes, including productivity gains, cycle‑time reduction, adoption, solution reliability, employee experience, and cost avoidance.
Communicate the value, impact, and return on investment (ROI) of the MAPP CoE clearly and credibly to stakeholders and leadership, as part of responsible stewardship of resources.

7. Run the MAPP CoE as a focused, high‑impact delivery and enablement outfit

Balance and prioritise capacity across solution build, consultation, enablement, and maintenance.
Lead a hybrid team comprising CAG staff and contingent onshore and offshore resources.
Manage vendor and manpower agency relationships to ensure delivery quality, continuity, and cost‑effectiveness, while minimising long‑term dependency.
Lead the team using pragmatic agile practices. Take time to understand and respect existing ways of working before making changes, improving processes incrementally only where it meaningfully improves delivery outcomes.
Partner closely with other CAG CoEs and technology teams to ensure no wrong doors for employees, smooth hand‑offs, and shared standards.

You must have

A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
Around 8+ years’ experience in software development, automation engineering, platform delivery, or AI‑enabled solution development.
Strong hands‑on experience with Microsoft technologies such as Power Platform, Copilot Studio, and Azure services, or comparable ecosystems.
Experience designing and operating production systems, with a strong focus on quality, security, and lifecycle management.
Experience leading mixed teams of engineers, Business Analysts, and contingent resources.
Strong ability to translate ambiguous business problems into practical, scalable technical solutions.
Comfort operating in evolving problem spaces and keeping pace with fast‑moving AI and platform capabilities.

You would be a great fit if you have

Experience building or operating task‑oriented or conversational AI agents.
Deep familiarity with the Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Copilot, and Azure ecosystem.
Experience working with governance, security, or assurance teams on platform enablement.
Experience managing onshore and offshore delivery teams and vendors.
A pragmatic leadership style that balances experimentation with restraint and sustainability.

What success looks like

The MAPP CoE consistently delivers high‑quality, production‑grade automation and AI agents on Microsoft platforms.
Platform governance and controls benefit from strong, practical input from the MAPP CoE and work effectively in day‑to‑day operations.
Business teams are guided toward the right solution approaches, reducing failed builds, rework, and unmanaged risk.
Employees can confidently self‑build simple automations while relying on the MAPP CoE for complex solutions.
The impact and value of the MAPP CoE is visible, measurable, and clearly articulated to stakeholders.
The MAPP CoE remains trusted, relevant, and resilient as CAG’s Microsoft agent and automation capability continues to evolve.

Functiebeschrijving

Je maakt deel uit van de afdeling die bijdraagt aan verschillende digitaliseringsprojecten en meedenkt over de verschillende overheidsprogramma’s in de gezondheidsector.

Als .Net & Blazor Software Developer heb je de volgende verantwoordelijkheden :

Nieuwe functionaliteiten ontwerpen en ontwikkelen die gebaseerd zijn op de gebruikersbehoeften.
Bugs identificeren en corrigeren om het systeem nog stabieler te maken.
De performance van het systeem opvolgen en analyseren en veranderingen aanbrengen ter optimalisatie.
De veiligheid van het systeem evalueren om eventuele kwetsbaarheden te identificeren, de veiligheidsstandaarden toepassen en ervoor zorgen dat de software beantwoordt aan de relevante veiligheidsvoorschriften en -normen.
De nieuwste technologische ontwikkelingen opvolgen, het nut van nieuwe technologieën evalueren en ze indien nodig in de bestaande systemen integreren.
Ondersteuning bieden aan de teamleden en eindgebruikers, deelnemen aan de oplossing van complexe technische problemen en aan de opstelling van de nodige documentatie.

Profiel

Je hebt een diploma in de Informatica en hebt minstens een eerste ervaring als .Net & Blazor Developer.

Je beheerst de volgende technologieën en tools: C#, Microsoft .NET, .NET Framework, Blazor, WCF, Web APIs in .NET, MVC, SQL, GIT.

Kennis van Azure Service Bus, NServiceBus en SharePoint zijn een pluspunt.

Je hebt goede analytische en logische vaardigheden, kan informatie kritisch beoordelen en de mogelijke alternatieven evalueren.

Je bent flexibel, wendbaar en je kan je aanpassen en veranderingen doorvoeren.

Je bent een goede teamspeler en houdt van uitwisselen en samenwerken.

Je hebt een passieve kennis van het Frans en een goede kennis van het Engels.

Wij bieden

jobs.title: Medior .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Software bouwen is jouw vak. Begrijpen hoe die software de dagelijkse werking beter maakt, jouw drive.
Denk je graag mee met de business, durf je een vraag kritisch te bekijken en neem je graag verantwoordelijkheid? Dan zit je hier op je plek.

Voor een Belgische onderneming binnen transport en logistiek
zoekt IN4Matic een Medior Fullstack .NET Developer
. Je komt terecht in een klein intern IT-team dat eigen toepassingen bouwt en onderhoudt. Van een klantenportaal tot koppelingen met transport- en magazijnsystemen: jouw werk helpt klanten hun zendingen op te volgen en collega’s efficiënter te werken.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt aan het eigen klantenportaal, de achterliggende integraties en de verdere automatisering van bedrijfsprocessen. Je denkt mee over wat nodig is en werkt oplossingen uit van technisch ontwerp tot implementatie en opvolging.

Concreet:

Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt het klantenportaal, zowel aan de frontend als de backend, en bouwt mee aan een nieuwe versie.
Je vertaalt operationele vragen naar werkbare software. Je vraagt door, toetst aannames en durft een andere aanpak voor te stellen als die beter aansluit bij de praktijk.
Je bouwt en beheert EDI-koppelingen met transport- en logistieke partners.
Je ontwikkelt API-integraties tussen het portaal, het transportmanagementsysteem, het magazijnsysteem en Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
Je automatiseert rapportering en dashboards om manueel werk voor operationele collega’s te verminderen.
Je onderzoekt productieproblemen, lost bugs op en biedt tweedelijnsondersteuning voor bestaande koppelingen.
Je houdt vanaf het ontwerp rekening met veiligheid, toegangsbeheer, invoervalidatie en gegevensbescherming.
Je gebruikt AI als klankbord in je dagelijkse werk: om ideeën af te toetsen, oplossingen te verkennen en je ontwikkelwerk te ondersteunen. Je blijft zelf kritisch beoordelen wat bruikbaar en correct is.
Je documenteert je oplossingen in Confluence en volgt je werk op in Jira, zodat collega’s ermee verder kunnen.

Wie zoeken we?

Je hebt ongeveer 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring als developer
en kunt zelfstandig een koppeling bouwen, een probleem uitzoeken en een degelijke oplossing opleveren. Wat je kunt realiseren en hoe je meedenkt, weegt zwaarder dan het exacte aantal jaren.

Je brengt het volgende mee:

Een sterke basis in fullstack .NET. Je werkt vlot met .NET, C# en SQL en voelt je thuis in zowel frontend- als backendontwikkeling.
Een stackagnostische blik. Je vertrekt vanuit het probleem en kiest de technologie die past. Je leert graag bij en kijkt verder dan je vertrouwde tools.
Inzicht in transport en logistiek. Begrippen zoals laadmeters, transportplanning en goederenstromen zijn je vertrouwd. Je begrijpt hoe de corebusiness en de bijbehorende IT-systemen op elkaar aansluiten.
Een kritische, communicatieve houding. Je luistert, vraagt door en durft je gesprekspartner constructief uit te dagen. Zo kom je samen tot een betere oplossing.
Ervaring met REST-API’s, JSON en Git, en het vermogen om zelfstandig te debuggen in een productieomgeving.
Aandacht voor onderhoudbare code, testen, veiligheid en duidelijke documentatie.
Interesse in AI en technologische ontwikkelingen. Je gebruikt AI graag als sparringpartner, wilt begrijpen hoe het werkt en onderzoekt welke nieuwe toepassingen echt iets toevoegen aan je werk.
Een dynamische, leergierige instelling. Je legt vlot contact en werkt graag samen met zowel IT-collega’s als mensen uit de operatie.
Een goede kennis van Nederlands en Engels, zodat je in beide talen vlot kunt samenwerken en communiceren.

Mooi meegenomen:
ervaring met maatwerksoftware binnen logistiek, Business Central en AL, EDI/OFTP2, Azure of Azure DevOps. Ook ervaring met een eigen softwareproduct of binnen een klein IT-team is een plus. Interesse in MCP, agentische tooling en het automatiseren van je ontwikkelworkflow sluit goed aan.

Wat maakt deze rol interessant?

Je ziet wat je werk oplevert. Je bouwt toepassingen die klanten en operationele collega’s dagelijks gebruiken. Hun feedback helpt je om gericht te verbeteren.
Je denkt mee over de business. Je krijgt ruimte om processen te begrijpen, vragen te stellen en mee te bepalen hoe software de werking kan ondersteunen.
Je krijgt eigenaarschap. Je groeit uit tot het technische aanspreekpunt voor het klantenportaal en de EDI-koppelingen, met perspectief om ook de rol van product owner op te nemen.
Je hebt invloed op de technische aanpak. .NET vormt een stevige basis, met ruimte om andere technologie en AI te verkennen wanneer die een concreet voordeel bieden.
Je werkt dicht bij je collega’s. In een klein intern IT-team tellen initiatief, kennis delen en samen oplossingen vinden.
Je krijgt ruimte voor kwaliteit. Degelijk ontwerpen, testen, veilig ontwikkelen en documenteren maken deel uit van de dagelijkse aanpak.

Division

GBS is the software solution delivery factory for Euroclear Core businesses such as Settlement, Asset Servicing, Funds, Collateral, Cash & Banking, and Corporate Services for all entities of the Groups.

The Cash & Banking Tribe is responsible for the design, delivery and evolution of IT solutions supporting Euroclear’s cash management, payments, liquidity, and banking services. The Tribe enables secure, resilient and efficient cash processing across the Group, while driving modernisation, regulatory compliance and operational excellence through close collaboration between business, IT and GBS delivery teams

The Senior Expert Engineer is accountable for the end‑to‑end design and technical integrity of the EasyWay business modules
, supporting Euroclear’s cash management, payments and banking services.

The role translates complex business, regulatory and operational requirements into secure, scalable and event‑driven software designs
, ensuring architectural coherence, resilience and compliance across the Cash & Banking landscape.

As a senior technical authority, the role provides expert guidance across squads
, supports delivery execution, and contributes to the modernisation and continuous evolution
of EasyWay and its ecosystem.

Solution & System Design

Own and design end‑to‑end EasyWay system architectures for the Cash domain, including orchestration, routing and integration flows.
Translate functional and non‑functional requirements into clear, implementable technical designs aligned with event‑driven and service‑oriented architectures.
Ensure solutions meet security, resilience, performance and regulatory requirements.
Validate and evolve existing designs to support scalability, modernisation and technical debt reduction.

Technical Leadership

Act as the senior technical reference for EasyWay, guiding squads on design choices, patterns, APIs and platform usage.
Review and challenge solution designs to ensure architectural consistency and cross‑system coherence.
Support resolution of complex delivery or production issues, contributing to root‑cause analysis and sustainable fixes.
Contribute to engineering standards, architectural principles and reusable assets related to EasyWay.

Delivery Enablement & Collaboration

Work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects and Engineers to ensure effective delivery of EasyWay Cash initiatives.
Support squads during implementation to ensure alignment between design intent and delivered solutions.
Collaborate across tribes and platforms to ensure end‑to‑end integration and dependency management.

Identify opportunities to improve robustness, maintainability, automation and operational efficiency.
Promote adoption of modern engineering practices and tooling aligned with Engineering Modernisation.
Share expertise through documentation, coaching and knowledge sharing.

Experience delivering solutions with high availability, resilience, security and performance requirements
Solid Knowledge in Angular and .Net development framework

Comfortable acting as a technical authority, guiding teams and challenging design decisions

Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Fluent in English and either French or Dutch, or both.

Microsoft Certified: Power Platform App Maker Associate (PL-100)

Our Core Areas of Expertise

Data & Technologies:
We design and implement large-scale, end-to-end architecture and data solutions, including data integration, data science, visualization, Big Data, AI, and Generative AI.

Cloud & Application Services:
We integrate leading platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, and IBM Maximo, helping clients transition to the cloud and improve operational efficiency.

Job Description

In this senior engineering position, you will take a strongly hands-on part in shaping and delivering robust software solutions supporting electronic trading and pricing workflows. The role calls for solid technical depth, extensive practical command of modern .NET development, and the confidence to take on intricate platform components. It represents a compelling chance to help build a brand-new greenfield platform in the fixed income electronic trading space, developed on AWS and current .NET technologies, where engineering excellence, reliability and production-ready delivery are central.

What would you be doing?

Architect, develop and maintain reliable .NET software components throughout every stage of the delivery lifecycle.
Assume direct, hands-on ownership of technically demanding platform components, keeping them resilient, maintainable, scalable and properly documented.
Exercise sound engineering judgement across architecture, design, implementation, testing and operational concerns.
Collaborate closely with trading, product, architecture, infrastructure and partner technology teams so that delivered solutions match business priorities.
Help strengthen engineering standards, including test automation, observability, secure coding, CI/CD and sound release management.

Qualifications

What are we looking for?

Expert command of C# and .NET/.NET Core, underpinned by a firm grasp of object-oriented design, SOLID principles and clean architecture.
Substantial background designing, developing and supporting ASP.NET Core Web APIs and RESTful services running in production.
Advanced knowledge of multi-threading, asynchronous programming, performance optimisation and distributed system design.
Demonstrated experience across SQL and NoSQL databases, covering data modelling, performance factors and operational support.
Practical exposure to containerisation technologies such as Docker, along with current deployment approaches.
Solid track record designing and delivering API-driven service-oriented or microservice architectures.
Rigorous approach to automated testing, spanning unit, integration and behaviour-driven testing with tools such as NUnit, Moq and Cucumber.
Wide-ranging experience with messaging and event-driven architectures based on technologies like RabbitMQ, TIBCO, SignalR or comparable platforms.
Considerable experience with continuous integration, continuous delivery and version control tooling such as Git, TeamCity or equivalent.
Real-world experience working within Agile delivery teams and helping refine the software lifecycle.
Background supporting live production systems, troubleshooting incidents and enhancing reliability, monitoring and operational readiness.
Advanced English (required). Spanish is a plus

Professional growth possibilities & learning opportunities

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

The Opportunity

You will be joining one of the Agile organisations in charge of designing, implementing, delivering and maintaining Reusable solution to simplify interoperability between diagnostics solutions (Roche and non-Roche instrumentation, LIS, HIS, Edge Systems…) to simplify the development to reduce complexity, time to market, cost of ownership and quality of our internal customers within R&D Departments at Roche Diagnostics.

This position will play a critical role in the team, leveraging deep expertise in Connectivity protocols and solutions and supporting the design, development, deployment and validation of future connectivity solutions while maintaining the current base of deployments across Roche. As a Software Engineer, you will be also lead the ASDLC adoption and Ways of working in your team while preserving quality standards and good software practices. You are expected to show a good customer centric mindset.

For this you will prove experience in .NET Software Development, Instrument connectivity protocols and Interoperability in general. You can communicate effectively in English with people of different profiles, cultures and your mentoring skills shall contribute to continuous improvement and delivering excellent software efficiently.

You will be responsible

You care about your team, leading technical discussions and complex initiatives. You can influence decisions within your area of responsibility and connect naturally with business and architecture representatives to provide solutions to our customers. You are able to manage technology, business and reality to design future feasible and efficient solutions.

Who you are:

Healthcare Interoperability & Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of healthcare and laboratory integration standards (e.g., HL7, POCT1-A, ASTM, LIS/HIS) and connectivity solutions for diagnostics environments
Software Development & Quality Practices: Proven hands-on C# .NET development background with strong expertise in software design patterns, object-oriented design, TDD/BDD, unit/integration testing, and maintainable code
End-to-End Ownership & AI Integration: Track record of full SDLC responsibility (from requirements to deployment), including integrating AI toolsets into development workflows and understanding cloud/frontend technologies
Technical Leadership & Architecture: Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor developers, design robust components, and guide architecture/AI strategy alongside product managers and stakeholders
Education, Communication & Soft Skills: Degree in CS or related field (Bachelor's + 6 years or Master's + 4 years), with strong problem-solving skills, independence, and fluent communication in English and Spanish for agile, cross-functional collaboration

Locations

You will be based in Sant Cugat, Spain.

Leadership Skills

You are also responsible for building, and then providing effective leadership for your team. Doing so in a manner that is consistent with the Roche Values and leadership capabilities. You will seek to inspire and lead your team to create transformative solutions, and to influence their prioritization and uptake in the wider organization, in order to ensure that customer solutions are at the forefront of the market and deliver its optimal contribution to the Roche Diagnostics Vision.

Both Diagnostics and Diabetes Care Leadership teams use these skills when referring to leadership. Consider bringing them into the job description.

The Expert SW Engineer in Mobile is expected to demonstrate the Roche Operating Principles and contribute to the Roche Group. The Roche Operating Principles are:

Put patients first
Follow the science
Act as one team
Embrace differences
Accelerate learning
Simplify radically
Make impact now
Think long term

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Materialise Medical, we believe that better healthcare starts with solutions designed around the individual patient. If you’re passionate about bringing personalized care to every patient, you’ll love being a part of this team. Through the technology we develop, researchers, engineers, and clinicians are revolutionizing personalized treatment — helping improve and save lives daily.

Job Title
: Software Automation Test Engineer

Job Description Summary

We are looking for an experienced Test Automation Engineer who will help us further develop and maintain our test automation framework.

The framework is already actively developed and has a strong technical foundation. We are looking for someone who can bring additional experience, ideas and engineering perspective to the area and work closely with the current owner to drive it further.

What we are looking for:

Strong experience in test automation and automation framework development
Strong C# / .NET skills
Hands-on experience with Playwright or similar modern browser automation frameworks
Good experience with API and integration testing
Good understanding of test architecture and different testing levels — Unit/Integration, Endpoint/API, Frontend and E2E
Experience with Azure DevOps
Experience with BDD and data-driven testing
Ability to work with complex systems, configurations, test environments and test data
Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills
AI-oriented mindset — practical experience with AI-assisted development and genuine interest in exploring how AI can improve test automation, maintenance, failure analysis and testing workflows
Strong ownership and initiative — not only implementing requested tests, but identifying problems, proposing improvements and following them through
Curiosity and willingness to challenge existing approaches constructively
Comfortable with technically challenging problems and areas where the solution is not yet obvious
Good collaboration skills — able to work closely with the current framework owner, developers and other engineers

Preferred Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mathematics, IT, Physics, or related fields (IT preferred).
At least 4 years of experience in QA, with 2+ years in test automation.
At least 2 years of experience testing web or desktop applications.

Required Skills

Technical Skills:

Programming skills in any object-oriented language and a willingness to switch to C#.
Knowledge of common principles of testing and test automation framework design.
Familiarity with Playwright or Cypress for C# UI automation (optional).
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (optional).

Soft Skills:

Strong problem-solving and bug-identification skills, with the ability to clearly articulate issues.
Results-oriented mindset with attention to detail.
Clear, structured communication skills.
Team player with system thinking and an Agile/Scrum mindset.

Language Skills:

English: Upper-intermediate level or higher.

What We Offer

At our company, we are on a mission to create a better and healthier world. By rapidly expanding our medical software teams, we are driving innovation in 3D planning and 3D printing technologies to make advanced, personalized care accessible to more patients—at a more affordable price.

Joining our team means becoming part of a forward-thinking organization that values impact, collaboration, and excellence. Here’s what we offer:

Purpose-Driven Work: Be part of a team that’s transforming healthcare by empowering surgeons and improving patient outcomes with cutting-edge 3D technologies.
Hybrid Work Policy: Enjoy the flexibility of working from home up to three days a week while staying connected to your team at the office at least two days per week.
A Growing Environment: Work in a dynamic, rapidly expanding team where innovation and personal growth are encouraged.
Collaborative Culture: Join a supportive, diverse team of experts passionate about making a tangible difference in the medical field.
Professional Development: Opportunities to grow your skills and expertise while working with the latest technologies in medical software.

Together, we’re shaping the future of personalized medicine—one patient at a time.

What’s Waiting For You

Work that matters

The technology we build at Materialise pushes the boundaries. You’ll find pride in building something that matters, whether you designed it, printed it, or shipped it. No matter your role, we unlock new possibilities to build a better and healthier world every day.

At Materialise, we expect you to think about the customer, not just the task. You push for better solutions and care about the difference your work makes.

A people-centered space

When you join Materialise, you join a group of colleagues invested in you, not just your work. From your own team to a department across the world, you’ll find a sense of belonging with people who help without being asked, challenge you, and have your back.

At the same time, we expect you to invest in the people around you — not just your own work — to make the group stronger than the sum of its parts.

An environment of trust

As a company of innovators, we know how crucial autonomy is in your work. When we hire you, we trust in your expertise, giving you space to organize your tasks, work flexibly, and make your own calls.

At Materialise, we expect you to deliver on that trust and keep your commitments.

A career ready to build

When you see opportunities for your career to grow at Materialise, we encourage you to go for them. People shape a fulfilling career at their own pace here.

At Materialise, we expect you to take initiative in your own development. Don’t wait for someone else to plan your career. Step into the space and make it count.

Make a difference together with the Medical team.

jobs.description:
¿Te imaginas participando en la transformación de las principales organizaciones nacionales e internacionales?

En Deloitte estamos comprometidos con generar un impacto en la sociedad, en nuestros clientes y en ti.

Sobre la posición

Buscamos incorporar un/a Gerente o Senior Manager de Consultoría Tecnológica para reforzar nuestro equipo de Ingeniería y Arquitectura de Datos .

La persona seleccionada tendrá un papel relevante en el crecimiento de la práctica, combinando desarrollo de negocio, liderazgo de clientes, definición de soluciones y dirección integral de proyectos de Data & Analytics . Buscamos un perfil con autonomía comercial, capacidad para gestionar iniciativas complejas y experiencia liderando equipos de consultoría en entornos tecnológicos exigentes.

Será responsable de impulsar oportunidades alrededor del dato, desarrollar relaciones de confianza con clientes y partners tecnológicos y asegurar la correcta ejecución técnica, económica y operativa de los proyectos bajo su responsabilidad.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Contribuir al desarrollo de nuestra oferta de Data Engineering, Data Architecture y Cloud Analytics , liderando tanto la actividad comercial como la ejecución de proyectos y la evolución del equipo.

La posición combina cuatro dimensiones principales:

Desarrollo de negocio y gestión de grandes cuentas.
Dirección técnica y económica de proyectos.
Soporte a la definición de arquitecturas y soluciones de datos.
Liderazgo, desarrollo y crecimiento de equipos.

¿Qué responsabilidades asumirás?

Desarrollo de negocio y liderazgo comercial

Identificar, desarrollar y liderar oportunidades comerciales relacionadas con Data Engineering, Cloud Analytics, Data Platforms y Data Strategy .
Gestionar la relación con clientes, generando nuevas oportunidades y contribuyendo a la apertura y desarrollo de cuentas.
Liderar procesos de preventa y respuestas a RFP complejas y de gran envergadura .
Coordinar la elaboración de propuestas, estimaciones económicas, modelos de prestación y planes de trabajo.
Realizar defensas comerciales y técnicas ante interlocutores de negocio y tecnología.
Definir propuestas de valor y soluciones alrededor de:
Data Strategy y Data Assessments.
Modern Data Platforms y Data Lakes.
Arquitecturas de datos cloud, híbridas y on-premise.
Business Intelligence y Analytics.
DataOps y MLOps.
Plataformas de streaming y procesamiento en tiempo real.

Desarrollar relaciones con alianzas y partners tecnológicos, identificando oportunidades conjuntas de mercado.

Dirección de proyectos y gestión económica

Dirigir de forma concurrente una cartera aproximada de tres o cuatro proyectos .
Asegurar el cumplimiento de los compromisos de alcance, calidad, plazo y presupuesto.
Gestionar riesgos, dependencias, planificación, capacidad y carga de los equipos.
Realizar el seguimiento financiero de los proyectos, incluyendo ingresos, costes, margen, previsiones y desviaciones.
Mantener una interlocución ejecutiva con los clientes durante todo el ciclo de vida de los proyectos.
Participar en la resolución de situaciones críticas, facilitando la toma de decisiones y la definición de planes de acción.
Asegurar la calidad de los entregables y la coherencia de las soluciones con los objetivos del cliente.

Liderazgo técnico y de solución

Liderar la definición de arquitecturas y soluciones de datos desde una perspectiva de management, viabilidad, valor y posicionamiento comercial .
Orientar a los equipos en la selección de tecnologías, patrones arquitectónicos y modelos de implantación.
Conectar las necesidades de negocio con soluciones de ingeniería y arquitectura de datos escalables, seguras y sostenibles.
Participar en revisiones de arquitectura, estimaciones, planes de transición y hojas de ruta tecnológicas.
Identificar riesgos técnicos y operativos durante las fases de preventa y ejecución.

Gestión y desarrollo de equipos

Liderar equipos de entre 10 y 20 profesionales , con capacidad para asumir estructuras superiores a 20-25 personas a medida que crezca la práctica.
Coordinar managers, arquitectos, especialistas, consultores y perfiles de ingeniería.
Crear equipo y desarrollar capacidades, favoreciendo la incorporación, formación y evolución de nuevos profesionales.
Realizar seguimiento del desempeño, desarrollo profesional, asignación y cargabilidad de los equipos.
Promover la colaboración, la autonomía y la transmisión de conocimiento.
Actuar como referente para el equipo, generando metodología, buenas prácticas y una cultura de excelencia técnica y orientación al cliente.

¿Qué perfil buscamos?

Experiencia profesional

Experiencia previa de más de 2 años desempeñando funciones de Gerente en proyectos de Data, Analytics, Cloud o transformación tecnológica.
Experiencia contrastada en la dirección técnica y económica de proyectos de consultoría.
Experiencia gestionando simultáneamente varios proyectos, con responsabilidad sobre plazos, riesgos, presupuesto, margen y equipos.
Experiencia en el desarrollo y gestión de grandes cuentas.
Experiencia liderando preventas, propuestas y respuestas a RFP.
Capacidad para definir y defender arquitecturas y soluciones de datos ante interlocutores técnicos y ejecutivos.
Experiencia en gestión de equipos de más de 10 personas.
Se valorará experiencia gestionando una unidad, cartera de proyectos o cuenta con responsabilidad sobre su rendimiento económico.

Formación

Titulación universitaria en:
Ingeniería Informática.
Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones.
Ingeniería Industrial.
Matemáticas.
Física.
Otras titulaciones técnicas equivalentes.

Idiomas

Inglés fluido (b2/c1, preferiblemente c1). Debes ser capaz de liderar reuniones, defender una arquitectura y redactar documentación técnica compleja en inglés.
Capacidad para participar en propuestas, reuniones y presentaciones en entornos internacionales.

Conocimientos tecnológicos

Buscamos un perfil con visión amplia de las arquitecturas de datos y capacidad para tomar decisiones y liderar soluciones. No es imprescindible ser especialista técnico hands-on en todas las tecnologías, pero sí disponer de conocimiento suficiente para orientar propuestas, validar arquitecturas y mantener conversaciones de alto nivel con clientes y equipos técnicos.

Se valorará el grado de experiencia en los siguientes ámbitos:

Arquitecturas y plataformas de datos

Arquitecturas de Analytics en entornos cloud, híbridos y on-premise.
Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, Lakehouse y Modern Data Platforms.
Procesamiento batch, streaming y arquitecturas orientadas a eventos.
Integración, gobierno, seguridad y calidad del dato.
DataOps, DevOps y MLOps aplicados a plataformas de datos.

Cloud y plataformas analíticas

Microsoft Azure : Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Synapse Analytics, Azure SQL, Analysis Services, Databricks, Delta Lake y Power BI.
Google Cloud Platform : Cloud Storage, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery y herramientas de visualización del ecosistema Google Cloud.
Amazon Web Services : AWS Lambda, Glue, S3, Redshift, Athena, Redshift Spectrum y Kinesis.
Snowflake .
Databricks .

Ingeniería e integración de datos

Apache Kafka, Kafka Connect y tecnologías de procesamiento de eventos.
Ecosistemas Hadoop y plataformas como Cloudera.
Bases de datos SQL, incluyendo Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server y MySQL.
Herramientas y patrones de integración, transformación y explotación de datos.

Certificaciones valorables

Se valorarán certificaciones profesionales relacionadas con:

Microsoft Azure.
Google Cloud Platform.
Amazon Web Services.
Snowflake.
Databricks.
Gestión de servicios y proyectos, como ITIL o PMP .

Las certificaciones serán consideradas un elemento positivo, aunque se priorizará la experiencia real en gestión de clientes, desarrollo comercial, liderazgo de equipos y dirección de proyectos.

Competencias clave

Orientación al cliente

Capacidad para comprender las prioridades del cliente, construir relaciones de confianza y convertir necesidades de negocio en iniciativas y soluciones concretas.

Comunicación e influencia

Comunicación ejecutiva, clara y convincente. Capacidad para presentar y defender propuestas ante responsables de negocio, CIO, CDO, responsables de arquitectura y equipos técnicos.

Autonomía comercial

Capacidad para desarrollar relaciones con clientes, abrir oportunidades, movilizar equipos internos y liderar defensas comerciales con poca dependencia de terceros.

Capacidad comercial

Experiencia liderando RFP complejas, articulando propuestas de valor, definiendo soluciones y coordinando los componentes técnicos, económicos y operativos de una oferta.

Liderazgo

Capacidad para dirigir equipos multidisciplinares, delegar responsabilidades, desarrollar talento y acompañar el crecimiento de la práctica.

Trabajo en equipo

Orientación a crear capacidad sostenible, compartir conocimiento y generar una comunidad de profesionales alrededor de la ingeniería y arquitectura de datos.

Gestión económica

Solidez en la elaboración y seguimiento de presupuestos, estimaciones, márgenes, previsiones, asignaciones y planes de capacidad.

Iniciativa y proactividad

Capacidad para anticipar necesidades, identificar oportunidades y tomar decisiones en contextos complejos o con información incompleta.

Visión tecnológica y de negocio

Capacidad para valorar una solución no solo por su adecuación técnica, sino también por su viabilidad económica, escalabilidad, impacto y alineamiento con la estrategia del cliente.

Otros requisitos

Flexibilidad para trabajar con diferentes industrias, clientes y equipos.
Capacidad para desenvolverse en entornos de crecimiento, transformación y elevada exigencia.
Orientación a resultados, calidad y generación de impacto.

¿Cómo es trabajar en Deloitte?

🤩 Proyectos de alto impacto
donde tendrás un largo recorrido y aprendizaje

☯️ Un día a día híbrido-flexible:
tendrás horario flexible y un buen equilibrio entre el teletrabajo y el trabajo en equipo en nuestras oficinas o las de nuestros clientes

⚽ Buen ambiente dentro y fuera de la oficina:
disfrutarás de varios teambuildings al año, actividades culturales y deportivas… ¡y mucho más!

🧘‍♀️ Bienestar integral:
cuídate con nuestro programa de salud física, mental y financiera… ¡y con equipo médico en las oficinas!

🤲 Impacto social:
Podrás apuntarte a una gran cantidad de voluntariados de alcance nacional e internacional y a proyectos pro-bono con los que poner tu tiempo y talento al servicio de quienes más lo necesitan

🗣️ Cultura del feedback y aprendizaje continuo:
crecerás en un entorno inclusivo donde la igualdad de oportunidades y tu plan personalizado de formación impulsarán tu desarrollo. ¿Ya te visualizas en la Deloitte University de París?

🤝 Beneficios exclusivos por ser parte de Deloitte:
podrás disfrutar de un gran catálogo de beneficios y de un completo plan de retribución flexible

Si te gusta lo que lees, estos son tus próximos pasos:

Si encajas en el puesto, nuestro equipo de talento te contactará para conocerte mejor
