jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Company

The Best of Both Worlds

At Maisa, we believe great work happens when people have the freedom to choose the setup that works best for them.

Prefer the flexibility of remote work?

You’re welcome to work remotely. Most of our roles are currently focused on Spain, although depending on the position and profile, we may be open to hiring from other locations.

Looking for some social energy?

Our hybrid setup gives you the option to connect and work alongside teammates at our hubs in Valencia, Barcelona, Madrid and Murcia

. And as we grow, our spaces will grow with us: when we build a team of more than 10 people in a location, our ambition is to create a hub there too.

We also want the time we spend together in person to be worth it. Today, that includes weekly transportation from the city center to our Valencia headquarters

and weekly team lunches in Valencia and Barcelona

, with more experiences to come as our teams and hubs evolve.

The Culture is OURS to Create

We’re still shaping how we work together—and that’s part of what makes joining Maisa now specifically exciting.

Everyone who joins has the opportunity to influence how we collaborate, connect, and build our culture. Rather than inheriting a finished playbook, you’ll have a voice in creating it.

Remote when you want flexibility. Together when you want connection. And a culture you can help shape from day one.

Welcome to Maisa – Making AI Accountable!

Maisa is building the next generation of Agentic Process Automation
, helping enterprises automate complex, decision-heavy processes that traditional automation can’t handle and GenAI alone can’t be trusted with. Our platform combines AI-driven reasoning with deterministic execution, enabling reliable, auditable, and enterprise-ready AI systems.

About The Role…

We’re seeking Forward Deployed Engineers to work at the intersection of engineering, product, and customers, deploying and adapting Maisa Studio
, our flagship Agentic Process Automation platform, to solve real-world enterprise problems.

Customer-Facing Engineering
Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their processes and goals. Design and implement solutions using Maisa Studio to automate complex workflows, acting as a trusted technical partner during onboarding and deployment while translating requirements into technical implementations and product feedback.

Collaboration & Product Feedback
Partner with product and engineering teams to influence roadmap development. Surface customer needs, edge cases, and scalability concerns while defining best practices, reference architectures, and reusable components that accelerate delivery.

Reliability, Security & Quality
Ensure deployments meet enterprise standards for reliability, performance, and security. Support customers in regulated environments by aligning with compliance requirements and collaborating with QA, SRE, and AppSec teams for stable rollouts.

What You’ll Do…

You will work closely with enterprise customers and internal teams to deliver robust, secure, and maintainable deployments in complex, often regulated environments, across 2 key technical domains:

Integrations & Supporting Services (Build what makes the use case work)

Configure, extend, and integrate Maisa Studio into customer environments, designing end-to-end solutions that include APIs, connectors, webhooks, serverless functions, microservices, and event-driven flows. Translate functional requirements from Automators and Technical Account Managers into concrete technical implementations using Go, Python, or JavaScript, clarifying ambiguities and proposing pragmatic paths forward. Ensure robustness through strong engineering practices including testing, logging, monitoring, and documentation. Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and support handover to internal teams or customers when applicable.

Customer Infrastructure Deployments / DevOps (On-prem & Customer Cloud)

Design and support deployments of Maisa Studio in customer environments, including on-premise and customer-managed cloud infrastructures. Work closely with customer DevOps, SRE, and Security teams to achieve production readiness, configuring platform requirements including authentication (OIDC, SAML), IAM, networking (VPNs, DNS, ingress/egress), and operational controls (deployment pipelines, monitoring, backups, high availability). Diagnose and resolve deployment-level incidents, ensure the platform operates within customer security and compliance requirements, and produce clear operational documentation including runbooks, deployment patterns, and troubleshooting guides.

What You’ll Bring…

You have strong experience as a Software Engineer, Solutions Engineer, DevOps/SRE Engineer, or Forward Deployed Engineer in customer-facing or delivery-oriented roles. You're comfortable operating in ambiguous environments, moving quickly from problem to solution while maintaining reliability, with strong troubleshooting skills across code, integrations, and infrastructure. You bring a customer-first mindset and can explain technical concepts clearly to drive alignment.

We are seeking candidates with one of two skill sets, or a mix of both:

Integrations & Supporting Services (Build what makes the use case work)

Strong experience as a backend or full-stack developer shipping production systems.
Hands-on experience with APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures/queues.
Familiarity with serverless and integration patterns commonly used in enterprise environments.
Strong debugging skills and comfort operating across code, infrastructure touchpoints, and workflow logic.

Customer Infrastructure Deployments / DevOps (On-prem & Customer Cloud)

Strong experience in DevOps / SRE, supporting production workloads.
Hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes, cloud providers and/or on-prem infrastructure, and networking fundamentals.
Practical experience with security and identity standards: OIDC, SAML, VPNs, certificates, and IAM concepts.
Ability to quickly understand customer infrastructure and adapt to their tools and processes.
Clear, structured communication with technical stakeholders in customer organizations.

Why join Maisa!

You will be joining one of Europe’s most exciting early-stage AI start-ups, where you’ll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge Agentic Process Automation that’s reshaping how enterprises approach AI deployment. You will get to directly influence how major multinational organizations transform critical business processes, working on genuinely differentiated technology that solves real enterprise AI challenges.

Following our recent $25m Seed Round, backed by leading Venture Capital firms including Creandum, Forgepoint, NFX, and Village Global, we’re scaling quickly and realising significant enterprise traction. This is your opportunity to help solve real AI enterprise challenges, working alongside deep technical and industry experts, where you will be challenged daily and expedite your learning and development.

Maisa is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all.

By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant. 

Based in the beautiful city of Porto, you’ll be part of our collaborative Engineering & Development teams, working closely with your peers and decision-makers to maintain and develop our global services and products.

As a Software Engineer, you are a builder who bridges the gap between high-level requirements and high-performance reality. Having advanced past foundational concepts, you are currently dedicated to growing your expertise in designing distributed systems that scale effectively. You don't just write code that works; you write code that thrives under the pressure of global data scales.

You will be an integral part of the development cycle, owning features from design to deployment. Working within an agile team, you’ll encounter exciting technical challenges, from low-latency optimizations to complex B2B integrations, in a culture where your voice is heard and your growth is prioritized.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Service Evolution:
Develop and maintain our core backend and middleware services, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and ready for global traffic.

Architectural Input:
Don't just follow blueprints, help draw them. By collaborating with more senior colleagues, you’ll participate in the design of software architectures that solve real-world business problems.

Data at Scale:
Write highly efficient code capable of handling massive amounts of data with ease.

Performance Engineering:
Implement performance-critical and low-latency solutions where every millisecond counts.

Production Insight:
Keep the services you build healthy in production. You'll instrument, monitor, and log them, then use those signals to debug real live issues, with support from the team as you ramp up.

Collaborative Growth:
Work within a peer-led environment where you’ll receive mentorship to constantly level up the team’s collective skill set.

Code Craftsmanship:
Actively participate in code reviews, advocating for "clean code" principles and maintainability.

Global Integration:
Build and support B2B integrations with partners and clients across the world, ensuring our data flows seamlessly across the ecosystem.

WHO YOU ARE

The Foundation:
You hold a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or have a similar technical background. You have 2+ years of professional experience in a comparable software engineering role.

OOP Specialist:
You have a strong grasp of Object-Oriented Programming and understand how to apply design patterns to keep complex systems manageable.

Comfortable with .NET (or eager to learn):
You are comfortable using .NET/C# or similar C based languages
. While we value core engineering principles, you’ll be hitting the ground running in a working .NET environment.

Distributed Thinker:
You have "hands-on" experience (or a very strong conceptual understanding) of Microservices and how they communicate in a distributed world.

Tooling Savvy:
You are a fluent Git user and feel right at home in a terminal, perhaps even wielding PowerShell or Bash to automate your daily workflow.

Clean Code Advocate:
You believe that code is read more often than it is written. You take pride in naming, structure, and documentation. You recognize technical debt when you see it and work with the team to chip away at it.

Test-Minded:
You treat automated tests as part of “done”, not an afterthought. You write tests alongside your code so it stays robust and so the next person can change it safely.

Security & Privacy Conscious:
You apply basic security and privacy principles by default, handle user data responsibly without exception, and raise a flag early when you spot a concern.

Agile Mindset:
You thrive in a collaborative environment. You understand that "Agile" is about iterative value, transparency, and constant feedback. You can size and prioritize your own work with input from the team, and you raise a hand early when something drifts off track.

Great Communicator:
You have strong conversational English skills (written and spoken) and enjoy the dynamic of working with colleagues from different time zones and cultures.

The opportunity

Unity Studio is our cutting-edge, browser-based real-time 3D authoring tool. Our current focus is on non-gaming use cases, with an ambitious vision to evolve Studio into a universal, web-based collaboration hub for any Unity Project.

As a QA Engineer on the Unity Studio team, you will be embedded in a fast-moving, cross-functional team building the future of web-based 3D creation. You will work hands-on across features, own the testing process end-to-end, and play a key role in helping us ship a high quality product with confidence.

You will collaborate closely with engineers, designers, and product managers from day one. You will have real ownership of the features you test, and the opportunity to shape how quality is approached as the team grows.

What You'll Be Doing

Carry out manual and exploratory testing across features and releases, working within an agile team
Own the QA process for the features you are assigned - from requirements through to sign-off
Write, manage, and maintain test cases and scripts to ensure full scope and coverage
Manage defects throughout their full lifecycle - logging, tracking, escalating, and verifying fixes
Work closely with engineers and product managers to review requirements, surface risks, and produce test plans
Participate in sprint ceremonies including stand-ups, planning, and retrospectives
Collaborate with the broader QA team and all other departments to ship with quality
Contribute to process improvements and help raise the quality bar across the team

Experience writing and executing manual test cases in line with project scope.
Strong experience with QA testing on web or mobile applications.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to work to tight deadlines, manage workloads, and escalate where required.
Comfortable collaborating across teams and communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

Experience with the Unity Engine or other interactive 3D tools

Experience with backend or API testing

jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for QA Engineers
to join iOENT and help ensure the quality and reliability of our products as we continue to grow our engineering teams.

You’ll work closely with developers and other stakeholders across the development lifecycle, combining hands-on manual testing with test automation. You’ll also have the opportunity to contribute to how QA works as we move towards more self-sufficient product teams with dedicated QA support.

What you’ll do

Plan and implement test automation across our products.
Design, develop and maintain automated tests and automation frameworks.
Review user stories and functional requirements and turn them into clear, effective test cases.
Plan, prioritise and coordinate testing activities.
Execute manual test cases and exploratory testing.
Work closely with developers to reproduce issues, understand fixes and ensure critical bugs are properly resolved.
Identify, document and track bugs through to resolution.
Perform regression testing following fixes and post-release testing after implementation.
Continuously improve testing processes and contribute to higher quality standards across existing and new features.

What we’re looking for

At least 2 years of hands-on QA experience across manual and automated testing.
Experience writing automated tests and maintaining automation frameworks.
Hands-on experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or similar browser automation tools.
Good knowledge of at least one programming language; JavaScript or TypeScript is preferred.
Experience creating clear test plans and test cases, including regression and exploratory testing.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate bugs, prioritise testing and manage multiple tasks.
Good professional English and strong collaboration skills when working with developers and other stakeholders.

What We Offer

Paid annual leave (as established by law).
Birthday day off.
3 additional wellness days per year.
Access to the Salu Digital Healthcare Program, plus the first three days of any claim for sick leave paid in full by the employer.
Monthly sports compensation (€55/month via Stebby).
Learning & Development budget in line with company policy.
Team event budget.
Hybrid working setup in Tallinn, with the option to work temporarily remotely for up to 60 days per calendar year.

Why this role and why iOENT?

This is a great time to join our QA team as we’re evolving the way QA works across iOENT. We’re moving towards more self-sufficient product teams, with QA working closely alongside developers and other team members throughout the development lifecycle.

You’ll join a growing QA function where you can make a practical impact: strengthening test automation, improving testing processes and helping teams deliver reliable, high-quality products.

At iOENT, you’ll have the opportunity to work collaboratively, take ownership of quality and continue developing your skills through hands-on work and dedicated learning support.
